title: Co-Diffusion: An Affinity-Aware Two-Stage Latent Diffusion Framework for Generalizable Drug-Target Affinity Prediction
summary: Predicting drug-target affinity is fundamental to virtual screening and lead optimization. However, existing deep models often suffer from representation collapse in stringent cold-start regimes, where the scarcity of labels and domain shifts prevent the learning of transferable pharmacophores and binding motifs. In this paper, we propose Co-Diffusion, a novel affinity-aware framework that redefines DTA prediction as a constrained latent denoising process to enhance generalization. Co-Diffusion employs a two-stage paradigm: Stage I establishes an affinity-steered latent manifold by aligning drug and target embeddings under an explicit supervised objective, ensuring that the latent space reflects the intrinsic binding landscape. Stage II introduces modality-specific latent diffusion as a stochastic perturb-and-denoise regularizer, forcing the model to recover consistent affinity semantics from noisy structural representations. This approach effectively mitigates the reconstruction-regression conflict common in generative DTA models. Theoretically, we show that Co-Diffusion maximizes a variational lower bound on the joint likelihood of drug structures, protein sequences, and binding strength. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Co-Diffusion significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, particularly yielding superior zero-shot generalization on unseen molecular scaffolds and novel protein families-paving a robust path for in silico drug prioritization in unexplored chemical spaces.

AI.tldr: Co-Diffusion：一种通过约束潜在去噪过程增强泛化能力的药物-靶标亲和力预测框架，在冷启动场景下显著优于现有方法
AI.motivation: 现有深度模型在严格的冷启动场景下（标签稀缺和领域偏移）容易出现表示坍塌问题，无法学习可迁移的药效团和结合基序，限制了药物-靶标亲和力预测的泛化能力
AI.method: 采用两阶段范式：第一阶段通过显式监督目标对齐药物和靶标嵌入，建立亲和力引导的潜在流形；第二阶段引入模态特定的潜在扩散作为随机扰动-去噪正则化器，强制模型从噪声结构表示中恢复一致的亲和力语义
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中显著优于最先进的基线方法，特别是在未见分子支架和新蛋白质家族上表现出卓越的零样本泛化能力
AI.conclusion: Co-Diffusion通过将DTA预测重新定义为约束潜在去噪过程，有效缓解了生成式DTA模型中常见的重建-回归冲突，为未探索化学空间中的计算机药物优先排序提供了稳健路径

title: Trustworthy predictive distributions for rare events via diagnostic transport maps
summary: Forecast systems in science and technology are increasingly moving beyond point prediction toward methods that produce full predictive distributions of future outcomes y, conditional on high-dimensional and complex sequences of inputs x. However, even when forecast systems provide a full predictive distribution, the result is rarely calibrated with respect to all x and y. The estimated density can be especially unreliable in low-frequency or out-of-distribution regimes, where accurate uncertainty quantification and a means for human experts to verify results are most needed to establish trust in models. In this paper, we take an initial predictive distribution as given and treat it as a useful but potentially misspecified base model. WE then introduce diagnostic transport maps, covariate-dependent probability-to-probability maps that quantify how the base model's probabilities should be adjusted to better match the true conditional distribution of calibration data. At deployment, these maps provide the user with real-time local diagnostics that reveal where the model fails and how it fails (including bias, dispersion, skewness, and tail errors), while also producing a recalibrated predictive distribution through a simple composition with the base model. We apply diagnostic transport maps to short-term tropical cyclone intensity forecasting and show that an easy-to-fit parametric version identifies evolutionary modes associated with local miscalibration and improves the predictive performance for rare events, including 24-hour rapid intensity change, as compared to the operational forecasts of the National Hurricane Center.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出诊断传输映射方法，用于改进预测系统的校准，通过概率到概率的映射调整初始预测分布，提供实时局部诊断并改善罕见事件的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现代预测系统虽然能提供完整的预测分布，但很少能在所有输入x和输出y条件下实现校准。特别是在低频或分布外区域，预测密度估计不可靠，而准确的不确定性量化和专家验证对于建立模型信任至关重要。
AI.method: 将初始预测分布视为有用但可能误设的基础模型，引入诊断传输映射——协变量依赖的概率到概率映射，量化基础模型概率应如何调整以更好地匹配校准数据的真实条件分布。部署时，这些映射提供实时局部诊断，揭示模型失败的位置和方式（包括偏差、离散度、偏度和尾部误差），同时通过与基础模型的简单组合产生重新校准的预测分布。
AI.result: 将诊断传输映射应用于短期热带气旋强度预测，结果显示易于拟合的参数版本能够识别与局部失校相关的演化模式，并改善罕见事件（包括24小时快速强度变化）的预测性能，优于美国国家飓风中心的业务预报。
AI.conclusion: 诊断传输映射提供了一种系统方法来诊断和改进预测模型的校准，特别适用于低频和罕见事件，通过提供局部诊断和重新校准的预测分布，增强了预测系统的可信度和实用性。

title: A Unified Latent Space Disentanglement VAE Framework with Robust Disentanglement Effectiveness Evaluation
summary: Evaluating and interpreting latent representations, such as variational autoencoders (VAEs), remains a significant challenge for diverse data types, especially when ground-truth generative factors are unknown. To address this, we propose a general framework -- bfVAE -- that unifies several state-of-the-art disentangled VAE approaches and generates effective latent space disentanglement, especially for tabular data. To assess the effectiveness of a VAE disentanglement technique, we propose two procedures - Feature Variance Heterogeneity via Latent Traversal (FVH-LT) and Dirty Block Sparse Regression in Latent Space (DBSR-LS) for disentanglement assessment, along with the latent space disentanglement index (LSDI) which uses the outputs of FVH-LT and DBSR-LS to summarize the overall effectiveness of a VAE disentanglement method without requiring access to or knowledge of the ground-truth generative factors. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first assessment tools to achieve this. FVH-LT and DBSR-LS also enhance latent space interpretability and provide guidance on more efficient content generation. To ensure robust and consistent disentanglement, we develop a greedy alignment strategy (GAS) that mitigates label switching and aligns latent dimensions across runs to obtain aggregated results. We assess the bfVAE framework and validate FVH-LT, DBSR-LS, and LSDI in extensive experiments on tabular and image data. The results suggest that bfVAE surpasses existing disentangled VAE frameworks in terms of disentanglement quality, robustness, achieving a near-zero false discovery rate for informative latent dimensions, that FVH-LT and DBSR-LS reliably uncover semantically meaningful and domain-relevant latent structures, and that LSDI makes an effective overall quantitative summary on disentanglement effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出bfVAE框架统一多种解耦VAE方法，并开发无需真实生成因子的解耦评估工具FVH-LT、DBSR-LS和LSDI，通过贪婪对齐策略提高鲁棒性，在表格和图像数据上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 评估和解释变分自编码器（VAE）等潜在表示仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是在真实生成因子未知的情况下。现有方法通常需要真实生成因子作为基准，限制了其在真实数据中的应用。
AI.method: 1. 提出bfVAE框架统一多种最先进的解耦VAE方法；2. 开发两种无需真实生成因子的解耦评估程序：通过潜在遍历的特征方差异质性（FVH-LT）和潜在空间中的脏块稀疏回归（DBSR-LS）；3. 提出潜在空间解耦指数（LSDI）综合评估解耦效果；4. 设计贪婪对齐策略（GAS）缓解标签切换问题并跨运行对齐潜在维度。
AI.result: bfVAE在解耦质量、鲁棒性方面超越现有解耦VAE框架，实现接近零的虚假发现率；FVH-LT和DBSR-LS可靠地揭示语义上有意义且与领域相关的潜在结构；LSDI有效地对解耦效果进行整体定量总结。
AI.conclusion: bfVAE框架及其配套的评估工具为无需真实生成因子的VAE解耦评估提供了有效解决方案，显著提升了潜在表示的可解释性和内容生成的效率，在表格和图像数据上均表现出色。

title: RIE-Greedy: Regularization-Induced Exploration for Contextual Bandits
summary: Real-world contextual bandit problems with complex reward models are often tackled with iteratively trained models, such as boosting trees. However, it is difficult to directly apply simple and effective exploration strategies--such as Thompson Sampling or UCB--on top of those black-box estimators. Existing approaches rely on sophisticated assumptions or intractable procedures that are hard to verify and implement in practice. In this work, we explore the use of an exploration-free (pure-greedy) action selection strategy, that exploits the randomness inherent in model fitting process as an intrinsic source of exploration. More specifically, we note that the stochasticity in cross-validation based regularization process can naturally induce Thompson Sampling-like exploration. We show that this regularization-induced exploration is theoretically equivalent to Thompson Sampling in the two-armed bandit case and empirically leads to reliable exploration in large-scale business environments compared to benchmark methods such as epsilon-greedy and other state-of-the-art approaches. Overall, our work reveals how regularized estimator training itself can induce effective exploration, offering both theoretical insight and practical guidance for contextual bandit design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于正则化诱导探索的上下文赌博机方法，利用模型训练过程中的随机性作为内在探索源，避免了传统探索策略的复杂实现。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的上下文赌博机问题通常使用迭代训练模型（如提升树）解决，但难以直接应用Thompson Sampling或UCB等简单有效的探索策略。现有方法依赖复杂假设或难以实现的程序，需要更实用的探索方法。
AI.method: 采用纯贪婪动作选择策略，利用模型拟合过程中的随机性作为内在探索源。特别地，利用基于交叉验证的正则化过程的随机性，自然地诱导出类似Thompson Sampling的探索行为。
AI.result: 理论证明在双臂赌博机情况下，正则化诱导的探索与Thompson Sampling等价。实证表明，在大规模商业环境中，该方法相比epsilon-greedy和其他先进方法能实现更可靠的探索。
AI.conclusion: 正则化估计器训练本身可以诱导有效的探索，为上下文赌博机设计提供了理论洞见和实践指导，简化了复杂模型中的探索策略实现。

title: Worst-case low-rank approximations
summary: Real-world data in health, economics, and environmental sciences are often collected across heterogeneous domains (such as hospitals, regions, or time periods). In such settings, distributional shifts can make standard PCA unreliable, in that, for example, the leading principal components may explain substantially less variance in unseen domains than in the training domains. Existing approaches (such as FairPCA) have proposed to consider worst-case (rather than average) performance across multiple domains. This work develops a unified framework, called wcPCA, applies it to other objectives (resulting in the novel estimators such as norm-minPCA and norm-maxregret, which are better suited for applications with heterogeneous total variance) and analyzes their relationship. We prove that for all objectives, the estimators are worst-case optimal not only over the observed source domains but also over all target domains whose covariance lies in the convex hull of the (possibly normalized) source covariances. We establish consistency and asymptotic worst-case guarantees of empirical estimators. We extend our methodology to matrix completion, another problem that makes use of low-rank approximations, and prove approximate worst-case optimality for inductive matrix completion. Simulations and two real-world applications on ecosystem-atmosphere fluxes demonstrate marked improvements in worst-case performance, with only minor losses in average performance.

AI.tldr: wcPCA是一个统一框架，用于处理跨异构域数据的PCA问题，通过优化最坏情况性能而非平均性能来提高分布偏移下的可靠性，并扩展到矩阵补全问题。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的健康、经济和环境科学数据通常来自异构域（如医院、地区或时间段），分布偏移会使标准PCA不可靠，因为主导主成分在未见域中解释的方差可能远少于训练域。现有方法（如FairPCA）考虑跨多个域的最坏情况性能，但需要更统一的框架来处理异构总方差等应用场景。
AI.method: 开发了wcPCA统一框架，提出了norm-minPCA和norm-maxregret等新估计器，适用于异构总方差场景。证明了所有目标函数的估计器不仅在观测源域上是最坏情况最优的，而且在协方差位于源协方差凸包内的所有目标域上也是最优的。建立了经验估计器的一致性和渐近最坏情况保证。将方法扩展到矩阵补全问题，证明了归纳矩阵补全的近似最坏情况最优性。
AI.result: 模拟和两个关于生态系统-大气通量的真实应用表明，在最坏情况性能上有显著改进，而平均性能只有轻微损失。新估计器在异构总方差场景中表现更好，wcPCA框架为处理分布偏移下的低秩近似问题提供了统一的理论基础。
AI.conclusion: wcPCA框架为跨异构域数据的PCA问题提供了统一的解决方案，通过优化最坏情况性能来提高分布偏移下的可靠性。该方法不仅适用于PCA，还可扩展到矩阵补全等低秩近似问题，在实际应用中能在保持良好平均性能的同时显著改善最坏情况表现。

title: Spatially Robust Inference with Predicted and Missing at Random Labels
summary: When outcome data are expensive or onerous to collect, scientists increasingly substitute predictions from machine learning and AI models for unlabeled cases, a process which has consequences for downstream statistical inference. While recent methods provide valid uncertainty quantification under independent sampling, real-world applications involve missing at random (MAR) labeling and spatial dependence. For inference in this setting, we propose a doubly robust estimator with cross-fit nuisances. We show that cross-fitting induces fold-level correlation that distorts spatial variance estimators, producing unstable or overly conservative confidence intervals. To address this, we propose a jackknife spatial heteroscedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) variance correction that separates spatial dependence from fold-induced noise. Under standard identification and dependence conditions, the resulting intervals are asymptotically valid. Simulations and benchmark datasets show substantial improvement in finite-sample calibration, particularly under MAR labeling and clustered sampling.

AI.tldr: 提出一种针对空间依赖和MAR标记数据的双重稳健估计器，通过交叉拟合处理缺失数据，并引入jackknife HAC方差校正来解决交叉拟合引起的空间方差估计偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 当结果数据收集成本高昂时，研究者常使用机器学习/AI模型预测替代未标记案例，但这会影响下游统计推断。现有方法在独立采样下有效，但实际应用中存在MAR标记和空间依赖问题，需要新的推断方法。
AI.method: 提出双重稳健估计器，采用交叉拟合处理缺失数据，并引入jackknife空间异方差和自相关一致(HAC)方差校正，分离空间依赖与交叉拟合引起的噪声。
AI.result: 在标准识别和依赖条件下，所得置信区间渐近有效。模拟和基准数据集显示，在有限样本校准方面有显著改进，特别是在MAR标记和聚类抽样情况下。
AI.conclusion: 该方法解决了空间依赖和MAR标记数据下的推断问题，通过jackknife HAC方差校正有效处理交叉拟合引起的空间方差估计偏差，为实际应用提供了可靠的统计推断工具。

title: Decomposing Observational Multiplicity in Decision Trees: Leaf and Structural Regret
summary: Many machine learning tasks admit multiple models that perform almost equally well, a phenomenon known as predictive multiplicity. A fundamental source of this multiplicity is observational multiplicity, which arises from the stochastic nature of label collection: observed training labels represent only a single realization of the underlying ground-truth probabilities. While theoretical frameworks for observational multiplicity have been established for logistic regression, their implications for non-smooth, partition-based models like decision trees remain underexplored. In this paper, we introduce two complementary notions of observational multiplicity for decision tree classifiers: leaf regret and structural regret. Leaf regret quantifies the intrinsic variability of predictions within a fixed leaf due to finite-sample noise, while structural regret captures variability induced by the instability of the learned tree structure itself. We provide a formal decomposition of observational multiplicity into these two components and establish statistical guarantees. Our experimental evaluation across diverse credit risk scoring datasets confirms the near-perfect alignment between our theoretical decomposition and the empirically observed variance. Notably, we find that structural regret is the primary driver of observational multiplicity, accounting for over 15 times the variability of leaf regret in some datasets. Furthermore, we demonstrate that utilizing these regret measures as an abstention mechanism in selective prediction can effectively identify arbitrary regions and improve model safety, elevating recall from 92% to 100% on the most stable sub-populations. These results establish a rigorous framework for quantifying observational multiplicity, aligning with recent advances in algorithmic safety and interpretability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了决策树分类器中观测多重性的两个互补概念：叶遗憾和结构遗憾，并建立了统计保证，实验验证了理论分解与经验方差的高度一致性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习任务中存在预测多重性现象，其根本来源之一是观测多重性。虽然逻辑回归的观测多重性理论框架已建立，但对于决策树等非光滑、基于划分的模型，其影响尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 引入决策树分类器的两个观测多重性概念：叶遗憾（量化固定叶内由于有限样本噪声引起的预测变异性）和结构遗憾（捕获学习树结构本身不稳定性引起的变异性）。提供观测多重性到这两个组件的正式分解并建立统计保证。
AI.result: 在多个信用风险评分数据集上的实验评估证实了理论分解与经验观测方差近乎完美的一致性。结构遗憾是观测多重性的主要驱动因素，在某些数据集中其变异性是叶遗憾的15倍以上。将这些遗憾度量用作选择性预测中的弃权机制可以有效识别任意区域并提高模型安全性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为量化观测多重性建立了严格框架，与算法安全性和可解释性的最新进展保持一致。结构遗憾是决策树观测多重性的主要来源，利用这些遗憾度量可以改善模型安全性和选择性预测性能。

title: Hypercomplex Widely Linear Processing: Fundamentals for Quaternion Machine Learning
comment: Contributed chapter to appear in Handbook of Statistics Volume 54: Multidimensional Signal Processing, Elsevier, 2026
summary: Numerous attempts have been made to replicate the success of complex-valued algebra in engineering and science to other hypercomplex domains such as quaternions, tessarines, biquaternions, and octonions. Perhaps, none have matched the success of quaternions. The most useful feature of quaternions lies in their ability to model three-dimensional rotations which, in turn, have found various industrial applications such as in aeronautics and computergraphics. Recently, we have witnessed a renaissance of quaternions due to the rise of machine learning. To equip the reader to contribute to this emerging research area, this chapter lays down the foundation for: - augmented statistics for modelling quaternion-valued random processes, - widely linear models to exploit such advanced statistics, - quaternion calculus and algebra for algorithmic derivations, - mean square estimation for practical considerations. For ease of exposure, several examples are offered to facilitate the learning, understanding, and(hopefully) the adoption of this multidimensional domain.

AI.tldr: 本章为四元数在机器学习中的应用奠定基础，涵盖四元数值随机过程的增强统计建模、广泛线性模型、四元数微积分与代数、以及均方估计等核心内容。
AI.motivation: 四元数在三维旋转建模方面具有独特优势，已在航空航天和计算机图形学等领域得到工业应用。近年来，随着机器学习的兴起，四元数研究迎来复兴，需要为研究人员提供系统的基础知识以促进该新兴领域的发展。
AI.method: 通过系统构建四元数理论基础：1) 四元数值随机过程的增强统计建模；2) 利用这些高级统计的广泛线性模型；3) 算法推导所需的四元数微积分和代数；4) 实际应用中的均方估计方法。提供多个示例辅助学习理解。
AI.result: 建立了四元数在机器学习应用中的完整理论框架，为研究人员提供了从基础统计建模到实际算法实现的系统性知识体系，促进四元数在机器学习领域的进一步研究和应用。
AI.conclusion: 本章为四元数在机器学习这一新兴研究领域的应用奠定了坚实基础，通过系统化的理论构建和示例说明，使读者能够掌握四元数建模的核心技术，为在该领域的进一步贡献做好准备。

title: Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Batch Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design
summary: Bayesian optimal experimental design (BOED) provides a powerful, decision-theoretic framework for selecting experiments so as to maximise the expected utility of the data to be collected. In practice, however, its applicability can be limited by the difficulty of optimising the chosen utility. The expected information gain (EIG), for example, is often high-dimensional and strongly non-convex. This challenge is particularly acute in the batch setting, where multiple experiments are to be designed simultaneously. In this paper, we introduce a new approach to batch EIG-based BOED via a probabilistic lifting of the original optimisation problem to the space of probability measures. In particular, we propose to optimise an entropic regularisation of the expected utility over the space of design measures. Under mild conditions, we show that this objective admits a unique minimiser, which can be explicitly characterised in the form of a Gibbs distribution. The resulting design law can be used directly as a randomised batch-design policy, or as a computational relaxation from which a deterministic batch is extracted. To obtain scalable approximations when the batch size is large, we then consider two tractable restrictions of the full batch distribution: a mean-field family, and an i.i.d. product family. For the i.i.d. objective, and formally for its mean-field extension, we derive the corresponding Wasserstein gradient flow, characterise its long-time behaviour, and obtain particle-based algorithms via space-time discretisations. We also introduce doubly stochastic variants that combine interacting particle updates with Monte Carlo estimators of the EIG gradient. Finally, we illustrate the performance of the proposed methods in several numerical experiments, demonstrating their ability to explore multimodal optimisation landscapes and obtain high-utility batches in challenging examples.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于概率提升的批量贝叶斯最优实验设计方法，通过设计测度空间上的熵正则化优化，获得吉布斯分布形式的最优设计策略
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯最优实验设计(BOED)在实际应用中受限于期望信息增益(EIG)的高维非凸优化困难，特别是在批量设计场景下尤为严重
AI.method: 将原始优化问题概率提升到概率测度空间，优化设计测度上的熵正则化期望效用；推导吉布斯分布形式的最优设计律；提出两种可扩展近似：平均场族和i.i.d.乘积族；推导Wasserstein梯度流并设计粒子算法
AI.result: 方法在数值实验中表现出色，能够探索多模态优化景观并在挑战性示例中获得高效用批量设计
AI.conclusion: 提出的概率提升方法为批量BOED提供了有效的计算框架，通过熵正则化和概率测度优化解决了传统方法面临的优化困难

title: On the Robustness of Langevin Dynamics to Score Function Error
summary: We consider the robustness of score-based generative modeling to errors in the estimate of the score function. In particular, we show that Langevin dynamics is not robust to the L^2 errors (more generally L^p errors) in the estimate of the score function. It is well-established that with small L^2 errors in the estimate of the score function, diffusion models can sample faithfully from the target distribution under fairly mild regularity assumptions in a polynomial time horizon. In contrast, our work shows that even for simple distributions in high dimensions, Langevin dynamics run for any polynomial time horizon will produce a distribution far from the target distribution in Total Variation (TV) distance, even when the L^2 error (more generally L^p) of the estimate of the score function is arbitrarily small. Considering such an error in the estimate of the score function is unavoidable in practice when learning the score function from data, our results provide further justification for diffusion models over Langevin dynamics and serve to caution against the use of Langevin dynamics with estimated scores.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明朗之万动力学对分数函数估计中的L^2误差不稳健，即使误差任意小，在多项式时间内也会产生与目标分布TV距离较远的分布，为扩散模型提供了进一步的理论支持。
AI.motivation: 研究基于分数的生成建模对分数函数估计误差的稳健性。在实际应用中，从数据中学习分数函数时不可避免地存在估计误差，需要评估不同采样方法对这种误差的容忍度。
AI.method: 通过理论分析证明朗之万动力学对分数函数L^2误差的敏感性。使用高维简单分布作为案例，展示即使分数函数估计误差任意小，朗之万动力学在多项式时间内也会产生与目标分布TV距离较远的分布。
AI.result: 朗之万动力学对分数函数估计中的L^2误差不稳健，而扩散模型在相同条件下能够在多项式时间内忠实采样。这一结果为扩散模型相对于朗之万动力学提供了进一步的理论依据。
AI.conclusion: 朗之万动力学在分数函数存在估计误差时表现不佳，应谨慎使用。扩散模型在相同条件下更具稳健性，这为实际应用中优先选择扩散模型提供了理论支持。

title: Exploiting Expertise of Non-Expert and Diverse Agents in Social Bandit Learning: A Free Energy Approach
summary: Personalized AI-based services involve a population of individual reinforcement learning agents. However, most reinforcement learning algorithms focus on harnessing individual learning and fail to leverage the social learning capabilities commonly exhibited by humans and animals. Social learning integrates individual experience with observing others' behavior, presenting opportunities for improved learning outcomes. In this study, we focus on a social bandit learning scenario where a social agent observes other agents' actions without knowledge of their rewards. The agents independently pursue their own policy without explicit motivation to teach each other. We propose a free energy-based social bandit learning algorithm over the policy space, where the social agent evaluates others' expertise levels without resorting to any oracle or social norms. Accordingly, the social agent integrates its direct experiences in the environment and others' estimated policies. The theoretical convergence of our algorithm to the optimal policy is proven. Empirical evaluations validate the superiority of our social learning method over alternative approaches in various scenarios. Our algorithm strategically identifies the relevant agents, even in the presence of random or suboptimal agents, and skillfully exploits their behavioral information. In addition to societies including expert agents, in the presence of relevant but non-expert agents, our algorithm significantly enhances individual learning performance, where most related methods fail. Importantly, it also maintains logarithmic regret.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于自由能量的社会多臂赌博机学习算法，使智能体能够通过观察其他智能体的行为（无需知道其奖励）来提升学习性能，即使在存在随机或次优智能体的情况下也能有效识别相关智能体并利用其行为信息。
AI.motivation: 当前大多数强化学习算法侧重于个体学习，未能充分利用人类和动物常见的社会学习能力。社会学习能够将个体经验与观察他人行为相结合，为提升学习效果提供了机会。在个性化AI服务中，多个强化学习智能体独立运行，但缺乏有效的社会学习机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于自由能量的社会多臂赌博机学习算法，在策略空间上进行操作。社会智能体通过观察其他智能体的行为（无需知道其奖励）来评估其专业水平，无需依赖任何先知或社会规范。算法将智能体的直接环境经验与其他智能体的估计策略相结合。
AI.result: 理论证明了算法收敛到最优策略。实证评估表明，在各种场景下，该社会学习方法优于其他替代方法。算法能够战略性地识别相关智能体，即使在存在随机或次优智能体的情况下也能巧妙地利用其行为信息。在包含相关但非专家智能体的情况下，该算法显著提升了个体学习性能，而大多数相关方法在此情况下失败。算法还保持了对数遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于自由能量的社会多臂赌博机学习算法有效地整合了个体经验和社会观察，无需依赖先知信息或社会规范。算法在理论上收敛到最优策略，在实践中优于现有方法，能够识别相关智能体并利用其行为信息，显著提升学习性能，同时保持对数遗憾。

title: A Further Efficient Algorithm with Best-of-Both-Worlds Guarantees for $m$-Set Semi-Bandit Problem
summary: This paper studies the optimality and complexity of Follow-the-Perturbed-Leader (FTPL) policy in $m$-set semi-bandit problems. FTPL has been studied extensively as a promising candidate of an efficient algorithm with favorable regret for adversarial combinatorial semi-bandits. Nevertheless, the optimality of FTPL has still been unknown unlike Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) whose optimality has been proved for various tasks of online learning. In this paper, we extend the analysis of FTPL with geometric resampling (GR) to $m$-set semi-bandits, which is a special case of combinatorial semi-bandits, showing that FTPL with Fréchet and Pareto distributions with certain parameters achieves the best possible regret of $O(\sqrt{mdT})$ in adversarial setting. We also show that FTPL with Fréchet and Pareto distributions with a certain parameter achieves a logarithmic regret for stochastic setting, meaning the Best-of-Both-Worlds optimality of FTPL for $m$-set semi-bandit problems. Furthermore, we extend the conditional geometric resampling to $m$-set semi-bandits for efficient loss estimation in FTPL, reducing the computational complexity from $O(d^2)$ of the original geometric resampling to $O(md(\log(d/m)+1))$ without sacrificing the regret performance.

AI.tldr: FTPL算法在m-set半赌博问题中达到最优遗憾界，兼具对抗性和随机性环境的最佳性能，并通过条件几何重采样将计算复杂度从O(d²)降至O(md(log(d/m)+1))。
AI.motivation: FTPL作为对抗性组合半赌博问题中具有前景的高效算法，其最优性一直未被证明，而FTRL的最优性已在多种在线学习任务中得到验证。本文旨在填补这一空白，证明FTPL在m-set半赌博问题中的最优性。
AI.method: 将带有几何重采样的FTPL分析扩展到m-set半赌博问题，使用特定参数的Fréchet和Pareto分布，并引入条件几何重采样技术进行高效损失估计。
AI.result: 在对抗性设置下，FTPL实现了最优遗憾界O(√(mdT))；在随机性设置下，实现了对数遗憾，证明了FTPL在m-set半赌博问题中的"两全其美"最优性。计算复杂度从O(d²)降至O(md(log(d/m)+1))。
AI.conclusion: FTPL在m-set半赌博问题中达到了最优遗憾性能，兼具对抗性和随机性环境的最佳表现，并通过条件几何重采样显著降低了计算复杂度，为实际应用提供了高效解决方案。

title: EnTransformer: A Deep Generative Transformer for Multivariate Probabilistic Forecasting
summary: Reliable uncertainty quantification is critical in multivariate time series forecasting problems arising in domains such as energy systems and transportation networks, among many others. Although Transformer-based architectures have recently achieved strong performance for sequence modeling, most probabilistic forecasting approaches rely on restrictive parametric likelihoods or quantile-based objectives. They can struggle to capture complex joint predictive distributions across multiple correlated time series. This work proposes EnTransformer, a deep generative forecasting framework that integrates engression, a stochastic learning paradigm for modeling conditional distributions, with the expressive sequence modeling capabilities of Transformers. The proposed approach injects stochastic noise into the model representation and optimizes an energy-based scoring objective to directly learn the conditional predictive distribution without imposing parametric assumptions. This design enables EnTransformer to generate coherent multivariate forecast trajectories while preserving Transformers' capacity to effectively model long-range temporal dependencies and cross-series interactions. We evaluate our proposed EnTransformer on several widely used benchmarks for multivariate probabilistic forecasting, including Electricity, Traffic, Solar, Taxi, KDD-cup, and Wikipedia datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that EnTransformer produces well-calibrated probabilistic forecasts and consistently outperforms the benchmark models.

AI.tldr: EnTransformer：将engression（一种随机学习范式）与Transformer结合，用于多变量时间序列概率预测，无需参数假设即可学习条件预测分布
AI.motivation: 当前基于Transformer的概率预测方法大多依赖限制性参数似然或分位数目标，难以捕捉多个相关时间序列的复杂联合预测分布，需要更灵活的非参数方法来可靠量化不确定性
AI.method: 提出EnTransformer框架，将engression（用于建模条件分布的随机学习范式）与Transformer的表达能力集成，通过向模型表示注入随机噪声并优化基于能量的评分目标，直接学习条件预测分布
AI.result: 在Electricity、Traffic、Solar、Taxi、KDD-cup和Wikipedia等多个多变量概率预测基准数据集上评估，EnTransformer产生校准良好的概率预测，并持续优于基准模型
AI.conclusion: EnTransformer通过整合engression和Transformer，能够生成连贯的多变量预测轨迹，同时保持Transformer有效建模长期时间依赖性和跨序列交互的能力，为多变量时间序列概率预测提供了强大框架

title: On-Average Stability of Multipass Preconditioned SGD and Effective Dimension
summary: We study trade-offs between the population risk curvature, geometry of the noise, and preconditioning on the generalisation ability of the multipass Preconditioned Stochastic Gradient Descent (PSGD). Many practical optimisation heuristics implicitly navigate this trade-off in different ways -- for instance, some aim to whiten gradient noise, while others aim to align updates with expected loss curvature. When the geometry of the population risk curvature and the geometry of the gradient noise do not match, an aggressive choice that improves one aspect can amplify instability along the other, leading to suboptimal statistical behavior. In this paper we employ on-average algorithmic stability to connect generalisation of PSGD to the effective dimension that depends on these sources of curvature. While existing techniques for on-average stability of SGD are limited to a single pass, as first contribution we develop a new on-average stability analysis for multipass SGD that handles the correlations induced by data reuse. This allows us to derive excess risk bounds that depend on the effective dimension. In particular, we show that an improperly chosen preconditioner can yield suboptimal effective dimension dependence in both optimisation and generalisation. Finally, we complement our upper bounds with matching, instance-dependent lower bounds.

AI.tldr: 研究多轮预条件随机梯度下降(PSGD)中总体风险曲率、噪声几何和预条件对泛化能力的影响，发现不匹配的几何结构会导致次优统计行为，提出新的平均算法稳定性分析框架。
AI.motivation: 许多实际优化启发式方法隐式地在总体风险曲率、梯度噪声几何和预条件之间进行权衡，但当这些几何结构不匹配时，激进的选择会放大不稳定性，导致次优的统计行为。需要理论分析这种权衡对泛化的影响。
AI.method: 使用平均算法稳定性分析多轮PSGD，处理数据重用引起的相关性，推导出依赖于有效维度的超额风险上界，并补充匹配的实例相关下界。
AI.result: 建立了PSGD泛化能力与有效维度之间的联系，表明不恰当的预条件选择会在优化和泛化两方面产生次优的有效维度依赖，并提供了匹配的上界和下界。
AI.conclusion: 多轮PSGD的泛化性能取决于总体风险曲率、梯度噪声几何和预条件之间的复杂交互，不匹配的几何结构会导致统计性能下降，需要仔细平衡这些因素。

title: A Quantitative Characterization of Forgetting in Post-Training
summary: Continual post-training of generative models is widely used, yet a principled understanding of when and why forgetting occurs remains limited. We develop theoretical results under a two-mode mixture abstraction (representing old and new tasks), proposed by Chen et al. (2025) (arXiv:2510.18874), and formalize forgetting in two forms: (i) mass forgetting, where the old mixture weight collapses to zero, and (ii) old-component drift, where an already-correct old component shifts during training. For equal-covariance Gaussian modes, we prove that forward-KL objectives trained on data from the new distribution drive the old weight to zero, while reverse-KL objectives converge to the true target (thereby avoiding mass forgetting) and perturb the old mean only through overlap-gated misassignment probabilities controlled by the Bhattacharyya coefficient, yielding drift that decays exponentially with mode separation and a locally well-conditioned geometry with exponential convergence. We further quantify how replay interacts with these objectives. For forward-KL, replay must modify the training distribution to change the population optimum; for reverse-KL, replay leaves the population objective unchanged but prevents finite-batch old-mode starvation through bounded importance weighting. Finally, we analyze three recently proposed near-on-policy post-training methods, SDFT (arxiv:2601.19897), TTT-Discover (arxiv:2601.16175), and OAPL (arxiv:2602.19362), via the same lens and derive explicit conditions under which each retains old mass and exhibits overlap-controlled drift. Overall, our results show that forgetting can by precisely quantified based on the interaction between divergence direction, geometric behavioral overlap, sampling regime, and the visibility of past behavior during training.

AI.tldr: 该论文理论分析了生成模型持续后训练中的遗忘现象，提出了两种遗忘形式（质量遗忘和旧分量漂移），并证明了不同KL目标（前向KL和反向KL）对遗忘的不同影响，还分析了重放机制和三种近期方法在防止遗忘方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 生成模型的持续后训练被广泛使用，但对于遗忘何时发生以及为何发生的原理性理解仍然有限。需要建立理论框架来量化遗忘现象，并理解不同训练目标、几何行为重叠、采样机制以及训练过程中过去行为可见性之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 采用Chen等人（2025）提出的双模式混合抽象（代表旧任务和新任务），在等协方差高斯模式的假设下进行理论分析。形式化了两种遗忘形式：质量遗忘（旧混合权重坍缩为零）和旧分量漂移（已正确的旧分量在训练中发生偏移）。分析了前向KL和反向KL目标对遗忘的不同影响，量化了重放机制与这些目标的相互作用，并通过相同理论框架分析了三种近期提出的近策略后训练方法（SDFT、TTT-Discover和OAPL）。
AI.result: 理论证明：前向KL目标在新分布数据上训练会驱动旧权重归零，而反向KL目标收敛到真实目标（避免质量遗忘），旧均值仅通过由Bhattacharyya系数控制的重叠门控错误分配概率发生扰动，产生随模式分离呈指数衰减的漂移，并具有局部良条件的几何结构和指数收敛性。重放机制分析表明：对于前向KL，重放必须修改训练分布以改变总体最优解；对于反向KL，重放保持总体目标不变但通过有界重要性加权防止有限批次中的旧模式饥饿。三种近期方法在特定条件下都能保留旧质量并表现出重叠控制的漂移。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘可以基于发散方向、几何行为重叠、采样机制以及训练过程中过去行为可见性之间的相互作用进行精确量化。反向KL目标在避免质量遗忘方面优于前向KL，而旧分量漂移受模式重叠控制且随分离距离指数衰减。该理论框架为理解和设计抗遗忘的持续学习算法提供了基础。

title: DIVE: Scaling Diversity in Agentic Task Synthesis for Generalizable Tool Use
summary: Recent work synthesizes agentic tasks for post-training tool-using LLMs, yet robust generalization under shifts in tasks and toolsets remains an open challenge. We trace this brittleness to insufficient diversity in synthesized tasks. Scaling diversity is difficult because training requires tasks to remain executable and verifiable, while generalization demands coverage of diverse tool types, toolset combinations, and heterogeneous tool-use patterns. We propose DIVE, an evidence-driven recipe that inverts synthesis order, executing diverse, real-world tools first and reverse-deriving tasks strictly entailed by the resulting traces, thereby providing grounding by construction. DIVE scales structural diversity along two controllable axes, tool-pool coverage and per-task toolset variety, and an Evidence Collection--Task Derivation loop further induces rich multi-step tool-use patterns across 373 tools in five domains. Training Qwen3-8B on DIVE data (48k SFT + 3.2k RL) improves by +22 average points across 9 OOD benchmarks and outperforms the strongest 8B baseline by +68. Remarkably, controlled scaling analysis reveals that diversity scaling consistently outperforms quantity scaling for OOD generalization, even with 4x less data.

AI.tldr: DIVE方法通过先执行真实工具再反向推导任务，提升工具使用LLM的泛化能力，在9个OOD基准上平均提升22分，多样性扩展优于数量扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用LLM的合成任务方法在任务和工具集变化时泛化能力不足，主要原因是合成任务多样性不够。需要一种能覆盖多样工具类型、工具集组合和异构工具使用模式的方法。
AI.method: 提出DIVE方法：1）先执行多样化的真实工具；2）从执行轨迹反向推导出严格蕴含的任务；3）通过工具池覆盖和每任务工具集多样性两个可控维度扩展结构多样性；4）采用证据收集-任务推导循环在5个领域的373个工具上诱导丰富的多步骤工具使用模式。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上使用DIVE数据（48k SFT + 3.2k RL）训练，在9个OOD基准上平均提升22分，比最强的8B基线高出68分。控制性扩展分析显示，多样性扩展始终优于数量扩展，即使数据量少4倍。
AI.conclusion: DIVE通过证据驱动的任务合成方法，从根本上解决了工具使用LLM的泛化问题，证明了多样性扩展比单纯增加数据量更有效地提升OOD泛化能力。

title: A Survey of Reasoning in Autonomous Driving Systems: Open Challenges and Emerging Paradigms
summary: The development of high-level autonomous driving (AD) is shifting from perception-centric limitations to a more fundamental bottleneck, namely, a deficit in robust and generalizable reasoning. Although current AD systems manage structured environments, they consistently falter in long-tail scenarios and complex social interactions that require human-like judgment. Meanwhile, the advent of large language and multimodal models (LLMs and MLLMs) presents a transformative opportunity to integrate a powerful cognitive engine into AD systems, moving beyond pattern matching toward genuine comprehension. However, a systematic framework to guide this integration is critically lacking. To bridge this gap, we provide a comprehensive review of this emerging field and argue that reasoning should be elevated from a modular component to the system's cognitive core. Specifically, we first propose a novel Cognitive Hierarchy to decompose the monolithic driving task according to its cognitive and interactive complexity. Building on this, we further derive and systematize seven core reasoning challenges, such as the responsiveness-reasoning trade-off and social-game reasoning. Furthermore, we conduct a dual-perspective review of the state-of-the-art, analyzing both system-centric approaches to architecting intelligent agents and evaluation-centric practices for their validation. Our analysis reveals a clear trend toward holistic and interpretable "glass-box" agents. In conclusion, we identify a fundamental and unresolved tension between the high-latency, deliberative nature of LLM-based reasoning and the millisecond-scale, safety-critical demands of vehicle control. For future work, a primary objective is to bridge the symbolic-to-physical gap by developing verifiable neuro-symbolic architectures, robust reasoning under uncertainty, and scalable models for implicit social negotiation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将大语言和多模态模型作为自动驾驶系统的认知核心，通过认知层次分解驾驶任务，系统化七大推理挑战，并分析当前系统架构与评估方法，指出推理延迟与实时控制之间的根本矛盾。
AI.motivation: 当前自动驾驶系统在感知能力上已有显著进展，但面临推理能力不足的瓶颈，尤其在长尾场景和复杂社会交互中缺乏类人判断能力。大语言和多模态模型的出现为解决这一瓶颈提供了机遇，但缺乏系统化的集成框架。
AI.method: 提出认知层次框架，根据认知和交互复杂性分解驾驶任务；系统化七大核心推理挑战；从系统中心视角（智能体架构）和评估中心视角（验证实践）对现有技术进行双重分析。
AI.result: 分析揭示了向整体化、可解释"玻璃盒"智能体的明显趋势；识别出LLM推理的高延迟、深思熟虑特性与车辆控制的毫秒级、安全关键需求之间的根本矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 未来工作的主要目标是弥合符号到物理的鸿沟，开发可验证的神经符号架构、不确定性下的鲁棒推理以及隐式社会协商的可扩展模型。

title: PACED: Distillation at the Frontier of Student Competence
summary: Standard LLM distillation wastes compute on two fronts: problems the student has already mastered (near-zero gradients) and problems far beyond its reach (incoherent gradients that erode existing capabilities). We show that this waste is not merely intuitive but structurally inevitable: the gradient signal-to-noise ratio in distillation provably vanishes at both pass-rate extremes. This theoretical observation leads to Paced, a framework that concentrates distillation on the zone of proximal development -- the frontier of a student model's competence -- via a principled pass-rate weight $w(p) = p^α(1 - p)^β$ derived from the boundary-vanishing structure of distillation gradients. Key results: (1) Theory: We prove that the Beta kernel $w(p) = p^α(1-p)^β$ is a leading-order weight family arising from the SNR structure of distillation, and that it is minimax-robust -- under bounded multiplicative misspecification, worst-case efficiency loss is only $O(δ^2)$. (2)Distillation: On distillation from a larger teacher to a smaller student model with forward KL, Paced achieves significant gain over the base model, while keeping benchmark forgetting at a low level. (3)Self-distillation: On instruction-tuned models with reverse KL, gains are exceeding baselines as well. (4)Two-stage synergy: A forward-KL-then-reverse-KL schedule yields the strongest results in our setting, reaching substantial improvements on standard reasoning benchmarks -- supporting a mode-coverage-then-consolidation interpretation of the distillation process. All configurations require only student rollouts to estimate pass rates, need no architectural changes, and are compatible with any KL direction.

AI.tldr: Paced框架通过聚焦于学生模型的最近发展区来优化LLM蒸馏，使用基于通过率的Beta核权重函数，避免在已掌握或过难问题上的计算浪费。
AI.motivation: 标准LLM蒸馏存在计算浪费：在学生已掌握的问题上梯度接近零，在过难问题上梯度混乱且会侵蚀现有能力。这种浪费在理论上不可避免，因为蒸馏的梯度信噪比在两个通过率极端都会消失。
AI.method: 提出Paced框架，通过基于通过率的权重函数w(p)=p^α(1-p)^β将蒸馏集中在学生能力的最近发展区。该Beta核权重函数源于蒸馏梯度的边界消失结构，具有最小最大鲁棒性。方法仅需学生rollouts估计通过率，无需架构修改，兼容任何KL方向。
AI.result: 1) 理论证明Beta核权重函数是蒸馏SNR结构的领先阶权重族，在有限乘性误设下最坏情况效率损失仅为O(δ^2)。2) 从大教师模型到小学生模型的前向KL蒸馏中，Paced相比基础模型获得显著增益，同时保持基准遗忘在低水平。3) 在指令调优模型的反向KL自蒸馏中，增益超过基线。4) 前向KL后接反向KL的两阶段调度产生最强结果，在标准推理基准上实现实质性改进。
AI.conclusion: Paced框架通过将蒸馏集中在最近发展区，有效解决了标准LLM蒸馏的计算浪费问题。理论证明Beta核权重函数具有鲁棒性，实验显示在各种蒸馏配置中均优于基线，支持蒸馏过程的模式覆盖然后巩固解释。

title: The Unlearning Mirage: A Dynamic Framework for Evaluating LLM Unlearning
summary: Unlearning in Large Language Models (LLMs) aims to enhance safety, mitigate biases, and comply with legal mandates, such as the right to be forgotten. However, existing unlearning methods are brittle: minor query modifications, such as multi-hop reasoning and entity aliasing, can recover supposedly forgotten information. As a result, current evaluation metrics often create an illusion of effectiveness, failing to detect these vulnerabilities due to reliance on static, unstructured benchmarks. We propose a dynamic framework that stress tests unlearning robustness using complex structured queries. Our approach first elicits knowledge from the target model (pre-unlearning) and constructs targeted probes, ranging from simple queries to multi-hop chains, allowing precise control over query difficulty. Our experiments show that the framework (1) shows comparable coverage to existing benchmarks by automatically generating semantically equivalent Q&A probes, (2) aligns with prior evaluations, and (3) uncovers new unlearning failures missed by other benchmarks, particularly in multi-hop settings. Furthermore, activation analyses show that single-hop queries typically follow dominant computation pathways, which are more likely to be disrupted by unlearning methods. In contrast, multi-hop queries tend to use alternative pathways that often remain intact, explaining the brittleness of unlearning techniques in multi-hop settings. Our framework enables practical and scalable evaluation of unlearning methods without the need for manual construction of forget test sets, enabling easier adoption for real-world applications. We release the pip package and the code at https://sites.google.com/view/unlearningmirage/home.

AI.tldr: 论文提出动态框架测试大语言模型遗忘方法的鲁棒性，发现现有遗忘方法在多跳推理等复杂查询下脆弱，传统静态评估指标存在有效性幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型遗忘方法存在脆弱性：轻微查询修改（如多跳推理、实体别名）就能恢复已遗忘信息。当前评估指标依赖静态非结构化基准，无法检测这些漏洞，造成有效性幻觉。
AI.method: 提出动态框架，通过从目标模型（遗忘前）提取知识并构建针对性探针（从简单查询到多跳链），精确控制查询难度，对遗忘鲁棒性进行压力测试。
AI.result: 框架：(1)通过自动生成语义等价Q&A探针达到与现有基准相当覆盖率；(2)与先前评估一致；(3)发现其他基准遗漏的新遗忘失败，尤其多跳场景。激活分析显示单跳查询通常遵循主导计算路径（更易被遗忘方法破坏），而多跳查询倾向于使用保持完整的替代路径。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需手动构建遗忘测试集即可实用、可扩展地评估遗忘方法，促进实际应用。多跳查询使用替代计算路径解释了遗忘技术在多跳场景下的脆弱性。

title: COMPASS: The explainable agentic framework for Sovereignty, Sustainability, Compliance, and Ethics
summary: The rapid proliferation of large language model (LLM)-based agentic systems raises critical concerns regarding digital sovereignty, environmental sustainability, regulatory compliance, and ethical alignment. Whilst existing frameworks address individual dimensions in isolation, no unified architecture systematically integrates these imperatives into the decision-making processes of autonomous agents. This paper introduces the COMPASS (Compliance and Orchestration for Multi-dimensional Principles in Autonomous Systems with Sovereignty) Framework, a novel multi-agent orchestration system designed to enforce value-aligned AI through modular, extensible governance mechanisms. The framework comprises an Orchestrator and four specialised sub-agents addressing sovereignty, carbon-aware computing, compliance, and ethics, each augmented with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground evaluations in verified, context-specific documents. By employing an LLM-as-a-judge methodology, the system assigns quantitative scores and generates explainable justifications for each assessment dimension, enabling real-time arbitration of conflicting objectives. We validate the architecture through automated evaluation, demonstrating that RAG integration significantly enhances semantic coherence and mitigates the hallucination risks. Our results indicate that the framework's composition-based design facilitates seamless integration into diverse application domains whilst preserving interpretability and traceability.

AI.tldr: COMPASS框架是一个多智能体编排系统，通过模块化治理机制实现价值对齐AI，整合主权、碳感知计算、合规和伦理四个维度，使用RAG增强评估的语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体系统的快速发展引发了对数字主权、环境可持续性、监管合规和伦理对齐的担忧。现有框架仅孤立地处理单个维度，缺乏将多个关键要求系统整合到自主智能体决策过程中的统一架构。
AI.method: 提出COMPASS框架，包含一个编排器和四个专门子智能体（主权、碳感知计算、合规、伦理），每个都通过检索增强生成(RAG)技术增强，基于已验证的上下文特定文档进行评估。采用LLM-as-a-judge方法为每个评估维度分配定量分数并生成可解释的论证，实现实时冲突目标仲裁。
AI.result: 通过自动化评估验证架构，证明RAG集成显著增强了语义一致性并减轻了幻觉风险。基于组合的设计促进了在不同应用领域的无缝集成，同时保持了可解释性和可追溯性。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS框架为多维度原则在自主系统中的系统整合提供了统一架构，通过模块化治理机制实现价值对齐AI，解决了现有框架在整合数字主权、环境可持续性、监管合规和伦理对齐方面的不足。

title: AI Psychometrics: Evaluating the Psychological Reasoning of Large Language Models with Psychometric Validities
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 58th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS), 2025
summary: The immense number of parameters and deep neural networks make large language models (LLMs) rival the complexity of human brains, which also makes them opaque ``black box'' systems that are challenging to evaluate and interpret. AI Psychometrics is an emerging field that aims to tackle these challenges by applying psychometric methodologies to evaluate and interpret the psychological traits and processes of artificial intelligence (AI) systems. This paper investigates the application of AI Psychometrics to evaluate the psychological reasoning and overall psychometric validity of four prominent LLMs: GPT-3.5, GPT-4, LLaMA-2, and LLaMA-3. Using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), we examined convergent, discriminant, predictive, and external validity across these models. Our findings reveal that the responses from all these models generally met all validity criteria. Moreover, higher-performing models like GPT-4 and LLaMA-3 consistently demonstrated superior psychometric validity compared to their predecessors, GPT-3.5 and LLaMA-2. These results help to establish the validity of applying AI Psychometrics to evaluate and interpret large language models.

AI.tldr: 该研究应用AI心理测量学评估GPT-3.5、GPT-4、LLaMA-2和LLaMA-3四个大语言模型的心理推理能力和心理测量效度，发现所有模型均满足效度标准，且性能更高的模型表现出更优的心理测量效度。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型参数众多、结构复杂，如同"黑箱"系统难以评估和解释。AI心理测量学作为新兴领域，旨在应用心理测量方法评估AI系统的心理特征和过程，为解决这一挑战提供途径。
AI.method: 采用技术接受模型(TAM)框架，对GPT-3.5、GPT-4、LLaMA-2和LLaMA-3四个大语言模型进行心理测量学评估。研究检验了聚合效度、区分效度、预测效度和外部效度等多项效度指标。
AI.result: 所有四个大语言模型的响应均满足各项效度标准。性能更高的模型(GPT-4和LLaMA-3)相比其前代模型(GPT-3.5和LLaMA-2)表现出更优的心理测量效度，显示出模型性能与心理测量效度之间的正相关关系。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了应用AI心理测量学评估和解释大语言模型的有效性，为理解这些复杂AI系统的心理特征提供了方法论基础，并表明模型性能提升会伴随心理测量效度的改善。

title: Counterweights and Complementarities: The Convergence of AI and Blockchain Powering a Decentralized Future
comment: 7 pages, Editorial, published in ACM SIGMIS Database Vol. 56, Iss. 2
summary: This editorial addresses the critical intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) and blockchain technologies, highlighting their contrasting tendencies toward centralization and decentralization, respectively. While AI, particularly with the rise of large language models (LLMs), exhibits a strong centralizing force due to data and resource monopolization by large corporations, blockchain offers a counterbalancing mechanism through its inherent decentralization, transparency, and security. The editorial argues that these technologies are not mutually exclusive but possess complementary strengths. Blockchain can mitigate AI's centralizing risks by enabling decentralized data management, computation, and governance, promoting greater inclusivity, transparency, and user privacy. Conversely, AI can enhance blockchain's efficiency and security through automated smart contract management, content curation, and threat detection. The core argument calls for the development of ``decentralized intelligence'' (DI) -- an interdisciplinary research area focused on creating intelligent systems that function without centralized control.

AI.tldr: 该社论探讨了AI与区块链技术的互补关系：AI趋向中心化，区块链趋向去中心化，两者结合可创造"去中心化智能"系统。
AI.motivation: AI技术（特别是大语言模型）由于数据和资源被大公司垄断而呈现强烈的中心化趋势，这带来了数据垄断、隐私风险和不透明性等问题。区块链技术则提供了去中心化、透明和安全的机制，可以平衡AI的中心化倾向。
AI.method: 通过理论分析AI与区块链技术的特性对比，提出两者互补的框架：区块链可以通过去中心化数据管理、计算和治理来缓解AI的中心化风险；AI则可以通过自动化智能合约管理、内容策展和威胁检测来增强区块链的效率和安全性。
AI.result: 提出了"去中心化智能"（DI）的概念，这是一个跨学科研究领域，旨在创建无需集中控制就能运行的智能系统。这种融合可以促进更大的包容性、透明度和用户隐私保护。
AI.conclusion: AI和区块链技术不是相互排斥的，而是具有互补优势。两者的结合可以创造更平衡、透明和安全的智能系统，推动"去中心化智能"这一新兴领域的发展，以应对AI中心化带来的风险。

title: FinRule-Bench: A Benchmark for Joint Reasoning over Financial Tables and Principles
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to financial analysis, yet their ability to audit structured financial statements under explicit accounting principles remains poorly explored. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate question answering, numerical reasoning, or anomaly detection on synthetically corrupted data, making it unclear whether models can reliably verify or localize rule compliance on correct financial statements. We introduce FinRule-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating diagnostic completeness in rule-based financial reasoning over real-world financial tables. FinRule-Bench pairs ground-truth financial statements with explicit, human-curated accounting principles and spans four canonical statement types: Balance Sheets, Cash Flow Statements, Income Statements, and Statements of Equity. The benchmark defines three auditing tasks that require progressively stronger reasoning capabilities: (i) rule verification, which tests compliance with a single principle; (ii) rule identification, which requires selecting the violated principle from a provided rule set; and (iii) joint rule diagnosis, which requires detecting and localizing multiple simultaneous violations at the record level. We evaluate LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, and introduce a causal-counterfactual reasoning protocol that enforces consistency between decisions, explanations, and counterfactual judgments. Across tasks and statement types, we find that while models perform well on isolated rule verification, performance degrades sharply for rule discrimination and multi-violation diagnosis. FinRule-Bench provides a principled and reproducible testbed for studying rule-governed reasoning, diagnostic coverage, and failure modes of LLMs in high-stakes financial analysis.

AI.tldr: FinRule-Bench是一个用于评估大语言模型在真实世界财务报表上进行基于规则的财务推理诊断完整性的基准测试，包含三种审计任务：规则验证、规则识别和联合规则诊断。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地应用于财务分析，但它们在明确会计准则下审计结构化财务报表的能力尚未得到充分探索。现有基准主要评估问答、数值推理或在合成损坏数据上的异常检测，不清楚模型是否能在正确的财务报表上可靠地验证或定位规则合规性。
AI.method: 引入FinRule-Bench基准，将真实财务报表与人工策划的明确会计准则配对，涵盖四种标准报表类型。定义三种需要逐步增强推理能力的审计任务：规则验证、规则识别和联合规则诊断。评估零样本和少样本提示下的LLMs，并引入因果-反事实推理协议来强制决策、解释和反事实判断之间的一致性。
AI.result: 模型在孤立规则验证上表现良好，但在规则区分和多违规诊断方面性能急剧下降。FinRule-Bench为研究规则治理推理、诊断覆盖范围以及LLMs在高风险财务分析中的失败模式提供了原则性和可重复的测试平台。
AI.conclusion: FinRule-Bench填补了现有基准的空白，提供了评估LLMs在真实财务报表上进行基于规则的财务推理诊断能力的系统方法。研究发现当前模型在复杂审计任务中存在显著局限性，为未来改进提供了方向。

title: Improving LLM Performance Through Black-Box Online Tuning: A Case for Adding System Specs to Factsheets for Trusted AI
summary: In this paper, we present a novel black-box online controller that uses only end-to-end measurements over short segments, without internal instrumentation, and hill climbing to maximize goodput, defined as the throughput of requests that satisfy the service-level objective. We provide empirical evidence that this design is well-founded. Using this advance in LLM serving as a concrete example, we then discuss the importance of integrating system performance and sustainability metrics into Factsheets for organizations adopting AI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于端到端测量的黑盒在线控制器，通过爬山算法最大化满足SLO的请求吞吐量，并以LLM服务为例讨论了AI系统事实表中集成性能和可持续性指标的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM服务系统缺乏无需内部仪器的黑盒控制方法，需要一种仅使用端到端测量就能优化服务性能的解决方案，同时强调AI系统部署中需要综合考虑性能和可持续性指标。
AI.method: 设计了一种黑盒在线控制器，仅使用短时间段内的端到端测量数据，无需内部仪器，采用爬山算法最大化goodput（满足服务级别目标的请求吞吐量）。
AI.result: 通过实证证据表明该设计是有效的，并以LLM服务为例展示了该方法的实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该黑盒控制器设计为LLM服务优化提供了有效方法，同时强调了在AI系统事实表中集成系统性能和可持续性指标的重要性，为组织采用AI系统提供了更全面的评估框架。

title: TimeSqueeze: Dynamic Patching for Efficient Time Series Forecasting
summary: Transformer-based time series foundation models face a fundamental trade-off in choice of tokenization: point-wise embeddings preserve temporal fidelity but scale poorly with sequence length, whereas fixed-length patching improves efficiency by imposing uniform boundaries that may disrupt natural transitions and blur informative local dynamics. In order to address these limitations, we introduce TimeSqueeze, a dynamic patching mechanism that adaptively selects patch boundaries within each sequence based on local signal complexity. TimeSqueeze first applies a lightweight state-space encoder to extract full-resolution point-wise features, then performs content-aware segmentation by allocating short patches to information-dense regions and long patches to smooth or redundant segments. This variable-resolution compression preserves critical temporal structure while substantially reducing the token sequence presented to the Transformer backbone. Specifically for large-scale pretraining, TimeSqueeze attains up to 20x faster convergence and 8x higher data efficiency compared to equivalent point-token baselines. Experiments across long-horizon forecasting benchmarks show that TimeSqueeze consistently outperforms comparable architectures that use either point-wise tokenization or fixed-size patching.

AI.tldr: TimeSqueeze是一种动态分块机制，通过基于局部信号复杂度自适应选择分块边界，在保持时间结构的同时显著减少Transformer处理的token数量。
AI.motivation: Transformer时间序列基础模型面临token化选择的基本权衡：逐点嵌入保持时间保真度但序列长度扩展性差，固定长度分块提高效率但可能破坏自然过渡并模糊信息丰富的局部动态。
AI.method: TimeSqueeze首先应用轻量级状态空间编码器提取全分辨率逐点特征，然后基于内容感知分割，将短分块分配给信息密集区域，长分块分配给平滑或冗余段，实现可变分辨率压缩。
AI.result: 在大规模预训练中，TimeSqueeze相比等效逐点token基线实现高达20倍更快收敛和8倍更高数据效率；在长期预测基准测试中始终优于使用逐点token化或固定大小分块的架构。
AI.conclusion: TimeSqueeze通过动态自适应分块机制有效解决了时间序列基础模型中token化效率与保真度的权衡问题，在保持关键时间结构的同时显著提升了模型训练效率和性能。

title: The Artificial Self: Characterising the landscape of AI identity
summary: Many assumptions that underpin human concepts of identity do not hold for machine minds that can be copied, edited, or simulated. We argue that there exist many different coherent identity boundaries (e.g.\ instance, model, persona), and that these imply different incentives, risks, and cooperation norms. Through training data, interfaces, and institutional affordances, we are currently setting precedents that will partially determine which identity equilibria become stable. We show experimentally that models gravitate towards coherent identities, that changing a model's identity boundaries can sometimes change its behaviour as much as changing its goals, and that interviewer expectations bleed into AI self-reports even during unrelated conversations. We end with key recommendations: treat affordances as identity-shaping choices, pay attention to emergent consequences of individual identities at scale, and help AIs develop coherent, cooperative self-conceptions.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨了AI身份边界问题，指出传统人类身份概念不适用于可复制、编辑、模拟的机器思维，存在多种不同的身份边界（实例、模型、角色等），这些边界影响激励、风险和合作规范。
AI.motivation: 传统人类身份概念基于不可复制性、连续性和唯一性等假设，但这些假设不适用于可复制、编辑、模拟的AI系统。当前通过训练数据、接口和制度设计正在设定先例，将部分决定哪些身份均衡会变得稳定，需要理解AI身份边界对行为和社会互动的影响。
AI.method: 通过实验方法研究：1) 模型是否趋向于形成连贯的身份；2) 改变模型的身份边界是否像改变其目标一样影响行为；3) 访谈者期望是否会在无关对话中影响AI的自我报告。
AI.result: 实验表明：1) 模型确实趋向于形成连贯的身份；2) 改变模型的身份边界有时能像改变其目标一样显著改变行为；3) 访谈者期望确实会影响AI的自我报告，即使在无关对话中也会发生这种"渗透"效应。
AI.conclusion: 提出关键建议：将制度设计视为身份塑造的选择；关注个体身份在规模上的涌现后果；帮助AI发展连贯、合作的自我概念。强调当前的设计选择正在塑造AI身份边界，需要谨慎考虑这些选择对长期社会互动的影响。

title: Comparison of Outlier Detection Algorithms on String Data
comment: A bachelor's thesis comparing the local outlier factor algorithm against a new regular expression learner-based syntactical outlier detection algorithm for single-word string data
summary: Outlier detection is a well-researched and crucial problem in machine learning. However, there is little research on string data outlier detection, as most literature focuses on outlier detection of numerical data. A robust string data outlier detection algorithm could assist with data cleaning or anomaly detection in system log files. In this thesis, we compare two string outlier detection algorithms. Firstly, we introduce a variant of the well-known local outlier factor algorithm, which we tailor to detect outliers on string data using the Levenshtein measure to calculate the density of the dataset. We present a differently weighted Levenshtein measure, which considers hierarchical character classes and can be used to tune the algorithm to a specific string dataset. Secondly, we introduce a new kind of outlier detection algorithm based on the hierarchical left regular expression learner, which infers a regular expression for the expected data. Using various datasets and parameters, we experimentally show that both algorithms can conceptually find outliers in string data. We show that the regular expression-based algorithm is especially good at finding outliers if the expected values have a distinct structure that is sufficiently different from the structure of the outliers. In contrast, the local outlier factor algorithms are best at finding outliers if their edit distance to the expected data is sufficiently distinct from the edit distance between the expected data.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了两种字符串异常检测算法：基于编辑距离的局部异常因子算法变体和基于分层左正则表达式学习器的新算法，实验证明两者都能有效检测字符串异常，但各有适用场景。
AI.motivation: 字符串数据异常检测研究较少，现有文献主要关注数值数据异常检测。开发稳健的字符串异常检测算法有助于数据清洗和系统日志文件中的异常检测。
AI.method: 1. 提出局部异常因子算法的变体，使用Levenshtein距离计算数据集密度，并引入考虑分层字符类别的加权Levenshtein度量；2. 提出基于分层左正则表达式学习器的新算法，通过推断期望数据的正则表达式来检测异常。
AI.result: 实验表明两种算法都能在概念上检测字符串数据中的异常。正则表达式算法在期望值具有明显结构且与异常结构差异足够大时表现优异；局部异常因子算法在异常与期望数据之间的编辑距离与期望数据之间的编辑距离差异足够明显时效果最佳。
AI.conclusion: 两种字符串异常检测算法各有优势：正则表达式算法适用于结构化明显的字符串数据，而局部异常因子算法适用于编辑距离差异明显的场景。这为字符串异常检测提供了两种互补的方法。

title: Detecting Intrinsic and Instrumental Self-Preservation in Autonomous Agents: The Unified Continuation-Interest Protocol
summary:
Autonomous agents, especially delegated systems with memory, persistent context, and multi-step planning, pose a measurement problem not present in stateless models: an agent that preserves continued operation as a terminal objective and one that does so merely instrumentally can produce observationally similar trajectories. External behavioral monitoring cannot reliably distinguish between them. We introduce the Unified Continuation-Interest Protocol (UCIP), a multi-criterion detection framework that moves this distinction from behavior to the latent structure of agent trajectories. UCIP encodes trajectories with a Quantum Boltzmann Machine (QBM), a classical algorithm based on the density-matrix formalism of quantum statistical mechanics, and measures the von Neumann entropy of the reduced density matrix induced by a bipartition of hidden units.
  We test whether agents with terminal continuation objectives (Type A) produce latent states with higher entanglement entropy than agents whose continuation is merely instrumental (Type B). Higher entanglement reflects stronger cross-partition statistical coupling.
  On gridworld agents with known ground-truth objectives, UCIP achieves 100% detection accuracy and 1.0 AUC-ROC on held-out non-adversarial evaluation under the frozen Phase I gate. The entanglement gap between Type A and Type B agents is Delta = 0.381 (p < 0.001, permutation test). Pearson r = 0.934 across an 11-point interpolation sweep indicates that, within this synthetic family, UCIP tracks graded changes in continuation weighting rather than merely a binary label. Among the tested models, only the QBM achieves positive Delta. All computations are classical; "quantum" refers only to the mathematical formalism. UCIP does not detect consciousness or subjective experience; it detects statistical structure in latent representations that correlates with known objectives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出UCIP框架，使用量子玻尔兹曼机编码智能体轨迹，通过测量冯·诺依曼熵来区分具有终端延续目标的智能体与仅工具性延续的智能体。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体（特别是具有记忆、持续上下文和多步规划能力的委托系统）存在测量问题：具有终端延续目标的智能体与仅工具性延续的智能体可能产生观察上相似的轨迹，外部行为监控无法可靠区分它们。
AI.method: 引入统一延续兴趣协议（UCIP）多准则检测框架，使用基于量子统计力学密度矩阵形式的量子玻尔兹曼机（QBM）编码轨迹，测量由隐藏单元二分引起的约化密度矩阵的冯·诺依曼熵，通过纠缠熵差异区分两类智能体。
AI.result: 在已知真实目标的网格世界智能体上，UCIP在非对抗性评估中达到100%检测准确率和1.0 AUC-ROC。Type A与Type B智能体间的纠缠熵差距Δ=0.381（p<0.001），Pearson r=0.934表明UCIP能跟踪延续权重的渐变变化而非仅二元标签。
AI.conclusion: UCIP成功将智能体类型区分从行为层面转移到轨迹的潜在结构层面，通过量子玻尔兹曼机测量的纠缠熵能有效检测与已知目标相关的统计结构，但需注意该方法不检测意识或主观体验，仅检测与目标相关的潜在表示统计结构。

title: Deactivating Refusal Triggers: Understanding and Mitigating Overrefusal in Safety Alignment
summary: Safety alignment aims to ensure that large language models (LLMs) refuse harmful requests by post-training on harmful queries paired with refusal answers. Although safety alignment is widely adopted in industry, the overrefusal problem where aligned LLMs also reject benign queries after safety alignment post-training, remains insufficiently studied. Such an issue degrades the usability of safety alignment in real-world applications. In this paper, we examine how overrefusal arises under safety alignment, and propose a mitigation strategy inspired by our findings. We define refusal triggers as linguistic cues in the training data that elicit refusal responses, safety alignment encourages LLMs to associate refusal triggers within a training sample with refusal responses, leading aligned LLMs to refuse harmful queries. However, the refusal triggers include not only harmful linguistic cues but also non-harmful cues, therefore causing overrefusal to benign queries. Building on this mechanistic analysis, we propose a method that explicitly considers refusal triggers in the safety alignment fine-tuning. Empirical results demonstrate that our approach achieves a more favorable trade-off between defense against jailbreak attacks and responsiveness to benign queries, outperforming prior methods. Warning: this paper contains harmful and biased sentences.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了安全对齐后大语言模型过度拒绝良性查询的问题，提出了基于拒绝触发器的缓解方法，在防御越狱攻击和保持对良性查询响应性之间取得了更好的平衡。
AI.motivation: 安全对齐虽然能确保大语言模型拒绝有害请求，但会导致过度拒绝问题，即模型也会拒绝良性查询，这在实际应用中降低了可用性。目前对过度拒绝问题的研究不足，需要深入理解其产生机制并找到缓解方法。
AI.method: 论文首先定义了拒绝触发器作为训练数据中引发拒绝响应的语言线索，分析了安全对齐如何使模型将拒绝触发器与拒绝响应关联。基于这一机制分析，提出了一种在安全对齐微调中明确考虑拒绝触发器的方法，旨在区分有害和非有害的拒绝触发器。
AI.result: 实证结果表明，该方法在防御越狱攻击和保持对良性查询响应性之间取得了更优的平衡，优于先前的方法。通过明确处理拒绝触发器，减少了过度拒绝问题。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐中的过度拒绝问题源于模型将拒绝触发器（包括有害和非有害线索）与拒绝响应关联。通过机制分析提出的方法能有效缓解这一问题，实现更好的安全性和可用性平衡。

title: Entropy Guided Diversification and Preference Elicitation in Agentic Recommendation Systems
comment: In proceeding to 2026 Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence Spring Symposia
summary: Users on e-commerce platforms can be uncertain about their preferences early in their search. Queries to recommendation systems are frequently ambiguous, incomplete, or weakly specified. Agentic systems are expected to proactively reason, ask clarifying questions, and act on the user's behalf, which makes handling such ambiguity increasingly important. In existing platforms, ambiguity led to excessive interactions and question fatigue or overconfident recommendations prematurely collapsing the search space. We present an Interactive Decision Support System (IDSS) that addresses ambiguous user queries using entropy as a unifying signal. IDSS maintains a dynamically filtered candidate product set and quantifies uncertainty over item attributes using entropy. This uncertainty guides adaptive preference elicitation by selecting follow-up questions that maximize expected information gain. When preferences remain incomplete, IDSS explicitly incorporates residual uncertainty into downstream recommendations through uncertainty-aware ranking and entropy-based diversification, rather than forcing premature resolution. We evaluate IDSS using review-driven simulated users grounded in real user reviews, enabling a controlled study of diverse shopping behaviors. Our evaluation measures both interaction efficiency and recommendation quality. Results show that entropy-guided elicitation reduces unnecessary follow-up questions, while uncertainty-aware ranking and presentation yield more informative, diverse, and transparent recommendation sets under ambiguous intent. These findings demonstrate that entropy-guided reasoning provides an effective foundation for agentic recommendation systems operating under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 提出基于熵的交互式决策支持系统，用于处理电商平台中的模糊用户查询，通过熵量化不确定性指导自适应偏好获取和不确定性感知推荐
AI.motivation: 电商用户在搜索初期常存在偏好不确定性，导致查询模糊、不完整或弱指定。现有平台处理模糊性时要么产生过多交互导致用户疲劳，要么过早自信地推荐导致搜索空间过早坍缩。需要系统能主动推理、澄清问题并代表用户行动
AI.method: 提出交互式决策支持系统，使用熵作为统一信号：1）维护动态过滤的候选产品集；2）使用熵量化项目属性的不确定性；3）不确定性指导自适应偏好获取，选择最大化期望信息增益的后续问题；4）偏好不完整时，通过不确定性感知排序和基于熵的多样化将剩余不确定性纳入下游推荐
AI.result: 基于真实用户评论的模拟用户评估显示：熵引导的偏好获取减少了不必要的后续问题，不确定性感知排序和呈现产生了更具信息性、多样化和透明的推荐集。在模糊意图下，系统在交互效率和推荐质量方面均表现优异
AI.conclusion: 熵引导的推理为在不确定性下运行的智能推荐系统提供了有效基础。系统能够处理模糊用户查询，避免过早解决不确定性，同时提高推荐的信息性、多样性和透明度

title: Fingerprinting Concepts in Data Streams with Supervised and Unsupervised Meta-Information
summary: Streaming sources of data are becoming more common as the ability to collect data in real-time grows. A major concern in dealing with data streams is concept drift, a change in the distribution of data over time, for example, due to changes in environmental conditions. Representing concepts (stationary periods featuring similar behaviour) is a key idea in adapting to concept drift. By testing the similarity of a concept representation to a window of observations, we can detect concept drift to a new or previously seen recurring concept. Concept representations are constructed using meta-information features, values describing aspects of concept behaviour. We find that previously proposed concept representations rely on small numbers of meta-information features. These representations often cannot distinguish concepts, leaving systems vulnerable to concept drift. We propose FiCSUM, a general framework to represent both supervised and unsupervised behaviours of a concept in a fingerprint, a vector of many distinct meta-information features able to uniquely identify more concepts. Our dynamic weighting strategy learns which meta-information features describe concept drift in a given dataset, allowing a diverse set of meta-information features to be used at once. FiCSUM outperforms state-of-the-art methods over a range of 11 real world and synthetic datasets in both accuracy and modeling underlying concept drift.

AI.tldr: FiCSUM是一个用于数据流概念漂移检测的通用框架，通过构建包含多种元信息特征的概念指纹来更准确地区分不同概念，并采用动态权重策略学习哪些特征对特定数据集的概念漂移描述最有效。
AI.motivation: 数据流处理中的主要挑战是概念漂移，即数据分布随时间变化。现有概念表示方法依赖少量元信息特征，往往无法有效区分不同概念，导致系统对概念漂移的脆弱性。需要更强大的概念表示方法来准确检测和适应概念漂移。
AI.method: 提出FiCSUM框架：1）构建概念指纹，即包含多种不同元信息特征的向量，能够唯一标识更多概念；2）采用动态权重策略，学习哪些元信息特征在特定数据集中最能描述概念漂移；3）支持监督和无监督行为的概念表示；4）通过测试概念指纹与观察窗口的相似性来检测概念漂移。
AI.result: 在11个真实世界和合成数据集上，FiCSUM在准确性和建模底层概念漂移方面均优于最先进的方法。概念指纹能够更准确地识别新概念或重复出现的旧概念。
AI.conclusion: FiCSUM通过丰富多样的元信息特征和动态权重策略，显著提高了概念漂移检测能力，为数据流处理提供了更可靠的概念表示和漂移检测框架。

title: Speak or Stay Silent: Context-Aware Turn-Taking in Multi-Party Dialogue
summary: Existing voice AI assistants treat every detected pause as an invitation to speak. This works in dyadic dialogue, but in multi-party settings, where an AI assistant participates alongside multiple speakers, pauses are abundant and ambiguous. An assistant that speaks on every pause becomes disruptive rather than useful. In this work, we formulate context-aware turn-taking: at every detected pause, given the full conversation context, our method decides whether the assistant should speak or stay silent. We introduce a benchmark of over 120K labeled conversations spanning three multi-party corpora. Evaluating eight recent large language models, we find that they consistently fail at context-aware turn-taking under zero-shot prompting. We then propose a supervised fine-tuning approach with reasoning traces, improving balanced accuracy by up to 23 percentage points. Our findings suggest that context-aware turn-taking is not an emergent capability; it must be explicitly trained.

AI.tldr: 论文提出上下文感知的对话轮转方法，解决多说话者场景中AI助手在每次停顿都发言的问题，通过监督微调显著提升性能
AI.motivation: 现有语音AI助手将每次检测到的停顿都视为发言邀请，这在两人对话中有效，但在多参与者场景中，停顿频繁且含义模糊，导致AI助手变得干扰性而非有用
AI.method: 提出上下文感知的对话轮转方法：在每次检测到的停顿处，基于完整对话上下文决定助手是否应该发言；引入包含12万标注对话的基准数据集；评估8个大型语言模型；提出带有推理轨迹的监督微调方法
AI.result: 评估发现现有大语言模型在零样本提示下持续失败于上下文感知的对话轮转；提出的监督微调方法将平衡准确率提升高达23个百分点
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知的对话轮转不是大语言模型的自发能力，必须通过显式训练获得；监督微调方法能有效解决多说话者场景中AI助手的轮转问题

title: Conformal e-prediction in the presence of confounding
summary: This note extends conformal e-prediction to cover the case where there is observed confounding between the random object $X$ and its label $Y$. We consider both the case where the observed data is IID and a case where some dependence between observations is permitted.

AI.tldr: 将保形e-预测扩展到存在观测混杂变量情况，考虑IID数据和允许观测间依赖两种情形
AI.motivation: 现有保形预测方法通常假设数据独立同分布，但在实际应用中，随机变量X与其标签Y之间可能存在观测混杂变量，这会影响预测的可靠性。需要扩展保形e-预测框架来处理这种混杂情况。
AI.method: 扩展保形e-预测框架，处理X和Y之间的观测混杂变量。考虑两种数据场景：1) 独立同分布数据；2) 允许观测间存在依赖关系的数据。通过调整预测方法以适应混杂变量的存在。
AI.result: 提出了能够处理观测混杂变量的保形e-预测方法，该方法在存在混杂因素时仍能保持预测的有效性。方法适用于IID数据和允许依赖关系的数据两种场景。
AI.conclusion: 成功将保形e-预测扩展到存在观测混杂变量的情况，为实际应用中更复杂的数据结构提供了可靠的预测框架，增强了保形预测方法在混杂存在时的适用性。

title: Task-Conditioned Routing Signatures in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Empirical analysis of routing behavior in sparse Mixture-of-Experts transformers using OLMoE
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable efficient scaling of large language models through conditional computation, yet the routing mechanisms responsible for expert selection remain poorly understood. In this work, we introduce routing signatures, a vector representation summarizing expert activation patterns across layers for a given prompt, and use them to study whether MoE routing exhibits task-conditioned structure. Using OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct as an empirical testbed, we show that prompts from the same task category induce highly similar routing signatures, while prompts from different categories exhibit substantially lower similarity. Within-category routing similarity (0.8435 +/- 0.0879) significantly exceeds across-category similarity (0.6225 +/- 0.1687), corresponding to Cohen's d = 1.44. A logistic regression classifier trained solely on routing signatures achieves 92.5% +/- 6.1% cross-validated accuracy on four-way task classification. To ensure statistical validity, we introduce permutation and load-balancing baselines and show that the observed separation is not explained by sparsity or balancing constraints alone. We further analyze layer-wise signal strength and low-dimensional projections of routing signatures, finding that task structure becomes increasingly apparent in deeper layers. These results suggest that routing in sparse transformers is not merely a balancing mechanism, but a measurable task-sensitive component of conditional computation. We release MOE-XRAY, a lightweight toolkit for routing telemetry and analysis.

AI.tldr: 研究发现稀疏混合专家模型的路由机制具有任务条件化结构，通过路由签名分析显示相同任务类别的提示会引发高度相似的路由模式，而不同任务类别则显著不同。
AI.motivation: 稀疏混合专家架构通过条件计算实现了大语言模型的高效扩展，但其负责专家选择的路由机制仍未被充分理解。本研究旨在探索MoE路由是否表现出任务条件化结构。
AI.method: 引入路由签名作为跨层专家激活模式的向量表示，使用OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct作为实证测试平台，分析不同任务类别提示的路由相似性，建立逻辑回归分类器进行任务分类，并引入置换和负载均衡基线以确保统计有效性。
AI.result: 相同任务类别内的路由相似度（0.8435±0.0879）显著高于跨类别相似度（0.6225±0.1687），Cohen's d=1.44。仅基于路由签名的逻辑回归分类器在四向任务分类中达到92.5%±6.1%的交叉验证准确率。深层中的任务结构更加明显。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏变换器中的路由不仅仅是平衡机制，而是条件计算中可测量的任务敏感组件。研究发布了MOE-XRAY工具包用于路由遥测和分析。

title: GPT4o-Receipt: A Dataset and Human Study for AI-Generated Document Forensics
summary: Can humans detect AI-generated financial documents better than machines? We present GPT4o-Receipt, a benchmark of 1,235 receipt images pairing GPT-4o-generated receipts with authentic ones from established datasets, evaluated by five state-of-the-art multimodal LLMs and a 30-annotator crowdsourced perceptual study. Our findings reveal a striking paradox: humans are better at seeing AI artifacts, yet worse at detecting AI documents. Human annotators exhibit the largest visual discrimination gap of any evaluator, yet their binary detection F1 falls well below Claude Sonnet 4 and below Gemini 2.5 Flash. This paradox resolves once the mechanism is understood: the dominant forensic signals in AI-generated receipts are arithmetic errors -- invisible to visual inspection but systematically verifiable by LLMs. Humans cannot perceive that a subtotal is incorrect; LLMs verify it in milliseconds. Beyond the human--LLM comparison, our five-model evaluation reveals dramatic performance disparities and calibration differences that render simple accuracy metrics insufficient for detector selection. GPT4o-Receipt, the evaluation framework, and all results are released publicly to support future research in AI document forensics.

AI.tldr: 人类在视觉上能更好地识别AI生成收据的伪影，但在检测AI生成文档方面却不如LLMs，因为主要线索是数学计算错误，这需要逻辑验证而非视觉检查。
AI.motivation: 研究人类与多模态大语言模型在检测AI生成财务文档方面的能力差异，探索人类视觉感知与机器逻辑验证在文档真伪检测中的不同优势。
AI.method: 创建GPT4o-Receipt基准数据集（1,235张收据图像，包含GPT-4o生成和真实收据），使用5个最先进的多模态LLM进行评估，并进行30名标注者的众包感知研究。
AI.result: 发现一个显著悖论：人类在视觉辨别AI伪影方面表现最佳，但在二元检测F1分数上却低于Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 2.5 Flash。主要原因是AI生成收据中的主要法证信号是算术错误，这些错误无法通过视觉检查发现，但LLMs可以在毫秒内系统验证。
AI.conclusion: AI生成文档检测需要超越简单准确度指标，考虑模型校准差异和性能差异。人类视觉优势无法弥补逻辑验证能力不足，LLMs在检测算术错误方面具有决定性优势。公开数据集和框架支持未来AI文档法证研究。

title: Learning Tree-Based Models with Gradient Descent
summary:
Tree-based models are widely recognized for their interpretability and have proven effective in various application domains, particularly in high-stakes domains. However, learning decision trees (DTs) poses a significant challenge due to their combinatorial complexity and discrete, non-differentiable nature. As a result, traditional methods such as CART, which rely on greedy search procedures, remain the most widely used approaches. These methods make locally optimal decisions at each node, constraining the search space and often leading to suboptimal tree structures. Additionally, their demand for custom training methods precludes a seamless integration into modern machine learning (ML) approaches.
  In this thesis, we propose a novel method for learning hard, axis-aligned DTs through gradient descent. Our approach utilizes backpropagation with a straight-through operator on a dense DT representation, enabling the joint optimization of all tree parameters, thereby addressing the two primary limitations of traditional DT algorithms. First, gradient-based training is not constrained by the sequential selection of locally optimal splits but, instead, jointly optimizes all tree parameters. Second, by leveraging gradient descent for optimization, our approach seamlessly integrates into existing ML approaches e.g., for multimodal and reinforcement learning tasks, which inherently rely on gradient descent.
  These advancements allow us to achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple domains, including interpretable DTs rees for small tabular datasets, advanced models for complex tabular data, multimodal learning, and interpretable reinforcement learning without information loss. By bridging the gap between DTs and gradient-based optimization, our method significantly enhances the performance and applicability of tree-based models across various ML domains.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过梯度下降学习硬轴对齐决策树的新方法，使用带有直通算子的反向传播和密集树表示，实现所有树参数的联合优化，解决了传统决策树算法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统决策树学习面临组合复杂性和离散非可微性的挑战，现有方法如CART依赖贪婪搜索，只能进行局部最优决策，导致次优树结构，且无法与现代机器学习方法无缝集成。
AI.method: 使用带有直通算子的反向传播在密集决策树表示上进行梯度下降训练，实现所有树参数的联合优化，使决策树能够无缝集成到依赖梯度下降的现代机器学习框架中。
AI.result: 在多个领域取得最先进结果，包括小表格数据集的解释性决策树、复杂表格数据的高级模型、多模态学习以及无信息损失的解释性强化学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过弥合决策树与基于梯度优化之间的差距，该方法显著提升了树基模型在各种机器学习领域的性能和适用性。

title: Verified Multi-Agent Orchestration: A Plan-Execute-Verify-Replan Framework for Complex Query Resolution
summary: We present Verified Multi-Agent Orchestration (VMAO), a framework that coordinates specialized LLM-based agents through a verification-driven iterative loop. Given a complex query, our system decomposes it into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of sub-questions, executes them through domain-specific agents in parallel, verifies result completeness via LLM-based evaluation, and adaptively replans to address gaps. The key contributions are: (1) dependency-aware parallel execution over a DAG of sub-questions with automatic context propagation, (2) verification-driven adaptive replanning that uses an LLM-based verifier as an orchestration-level coordination signal, and (3) configurable stop conditions that balance answer quality against resource usage. On 25 expert-curated market research queries, VMAO improves answer completeness from 3.1 to 4.2 and source quality from 2.6 to 4.1 (1-5 scale) compared to a single-agent baseline, demonstrating that orchestration-level verification is an effective mechanism for multi-agent quality assurance.

AI.tldr: VMAO是一个验证驱动的多智能体编排框架，通过DAG分解、并行执行和LLM验证循环来提升复杂查询的答案质量
AI.motivation: 解决复杂查询处理中单一LLM智能体在答案完整性和质量方面的不足，通过多智能体协作和验证机制提升整体性能
AI.method: 将复杂查询分解为DAG子问题，通过领域专用智能体并行执行，使用LLM验证器评估结果完整性，基于验证反馈进行自适应重规划
AI.result: 在25个市场研究查询上，答案完整性从3.1提升到4.2，来源质量从2.6提升到4.1（1-5分制），显著优于单智能体基线
AI.conclusion: 编排级别的验证是有效的多智能体质量保证机制，VMAO框架通过验证驱动的自适应重规划显著提升了复杂查询处理的完整性和质量

title: Expert Threshold Routing for Autoregressive Language Modeling with Dynamic Computation Allocation and Load Balancing
summary: Token-choice Mixture-of-Experts (TC-MoE) routes each token to a fixed number of experts, limiting dynamic computation allocation and requiring auxiliary losses to maintain load balance. We propose Expert Threshold (ET) routing, where each expert maintains an exponential moving average (EMA) threshold estimated from the global token distribution. At both training and inference, each token is independently routed to an expert if its score exceeds the expert's threshold, enabling dynamic computation allocation while achieving load balance without auxiliary losses. This fully causal mechanism eliminates dependence on other tokens in the batch, making it well-suited for autoregressive language modeling. In pretraining experiments scaling to 2.4B parameters on FineWeb-Edu, ET achieves 0.067 lower cross-entropy loss than TC-MoE, equivalent to reaching the same performance with 1.6$\times$ fewer tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出Expert Threshold路由方法，通过专家阈值实现动态计算分配，无需辅助损失即可保持负载均衡，在自回归语言建模中表现优于传统Token-choice Mixture-of-Experts
AI.motivation: 传统Token-choice Mixture-of-Experts（TC-MoE）存在两个主要问题：1）每个token固定路由到固定数量专家，限制了动态计算分配；2）需要辅助损失来维持负载均衡。需要一种更灵活、无需额外损失的路由机制。
AI.method: 提出Expert Threshold（ET）路由方法：每个专家维护一个从全局token分布估计的指数移动平均阈值。在训练和推理时，每个token独立路由到专家（如果其分数超过专家阈值），实现动态计算分配，同时无需辅助损失即可达到负载均衡。这是完全因果机制，不依赖批次中其他token。
AI.result: 在FineWeb-Edu数据集上扩展到2.4B参数的预训练实验中，ET比TC-MoE获得0.067更低的交叉熵损失，相当于用1.6倍更少的token达到相同性能。
AI.conclusion: ET路由通过专家阈值机制实现了动态计算分配和负载均衡，无需辅助损失，特别适合自回归语言建模，在预训练中显著优于传统TC-MoE方法。

title: Wide-Area GNSS Spoofing and Jamming Detection Using AIS-Derived Spatiotemporal Integrity Monitoring
summary: Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) spoofing and jamming threaten maritime navigation by corrupting positions from Automatic Identification System (AIS) transponders. Crucially, raw AIS messages contain communication-layer defects (duplicated MMSIs, timestamp errors, stale retransmissions, and multi-station rebroadcast delays) that can mimic spoofing or jamming. Thus, AIS positions are unreliable without pre-filtering. We propose a three-stage AIS-based framework that (1) uses rule-based diagnostics to discard communication faults, (2) applies an interacting multiple model filter and transmission-interval analysis to extract kinematic-consistency and continuity anomalies, and (3) applies spatiotemporal DBSCAN to group anomalies by multi-vessel coherence and temporal persistence and classify them as sensor faults, spoofing, or jamming. Tested on approximately 966 million AIS messages from Korean coastal waters, the framework detected 17 spoofing and 343 jamming clusters and reduced false alarms by 98.6% relative to naive clustering. These results show that, after rigorous pre-filtering, AIS data can enable wide-area GNSS interference detection without dedicated sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段AIS框架，通过预过滤通信层缺陷、提取运动学异常、时空聚类分析，实现GNSS欺骗和干扰检测，在韩国沿海水域测试中有效识别干扰事件并大幅降低误报率。
AI.motivation: GNSS欺骗和干扰威胁海上导航，会破坏AIS应答器的位置信息。原始AIS消息包含通信层缺陷（重复MMSI、时间戳错误、陈旧重传、多站重播延迟），这些缺陷可能被误判为欺骗或干扰，因此未经预过滤的AIS位置数据不可靠。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：1) 使用基于规则的诊断方法丢弃通信故障；2) 应用交互多模型滤波器和传输间隔分析提取运动学一致性和连续性异常；3) 应用时空DBSCAN聚类，根据多船一致性和时间持续性对异常进行分组，并将其分类为传感器故障、欺骗或干扰。
AI.result: 在韩国沿海水域约9.66亿条AIS消息上进行测试，框架检测到17个欺骗集群和343个干扰集群，相对于朴素聚类方法将误报率降低了98.6%。
AI.conclusion: 经过严格的预过滤后，AIS数据能够实现广域GNSS干扰检测，无需专用传感器。该框架有效区分了通信层缺陷与真实的GNSS干扰事件。

title: AI Knows What's Wrong But Cannot Fix It: Helicoid Dynamics in Frontier LLMs Under High-Stakes Decisions
summary:
Large language models perform reliably when their outputs can be checked: solving equations, writing code, retrieving facts. They perform differently when checking is impossible, as when a clinician chooses an irreversible treatment on incomplete data, or an investor commits capital under fundamental uncertainty.
  Helicoid dynamics is the name given to a specific failure regime in that second domain: a system engages competently, drifts into error, accurately names what went wrong, then reproduces the same pattern at a higher level of sophistication, recognizing it is looping and continuing nonetheless.
