However, under realistic assumptions, we show that ReRo can yield misleading risk estimates and violate claimed bounds, limiting their usefulness for principled DP calibration and auditing.
  This paper introduces reconstruction advantage, a unified risk metric that consistently captures risk across membership inference, attribute inference, and data reconstruction. We derive tight bounds that relate DP noise to adversarial advantage and characterize optimal adversarial strategies for arbitrary DP mechanisms and attacker knowledge. These results enable risk-driven noise calibration and provide a foundation for systematic DP auditing. We show that reconstruction advantage improves the accuracy and scope of DP auditing and enables more effective utility-privacy trade-offs in DP-enabled data management systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出重构优势作为统一的风险度量，替代传统重构鲁棒性，为差分隐私系统提供更准确的风险评估和噪声校准方法。
AI.motivation: 现有差分隐私风险分析主要关注成员推断攻击，或依赖重构鲁棒性度量。但在现实假设下，重构鲁棒性可能产生误导性风险估计并违反声称的边界，限制了其在系统化差分隐私校准和审计中的实用性。
AI.method: 引入重构优势作为统一风险度量，捕捉成员推断、属性推断和数据重构的综合风险。推导差分隐私噪声与对抗优势之间的紧致边界，并针对任意差分隐私机制和攻击者知识特征化最优对抗策略。
AI.result: 重构优势提高了差分隐私审计的准确性和范围，实现了更有效的效用-隐私权衡。该方法为风险驱动的噪声校准提供了理论基础，支持系统化的差分隐私审计。
AI.conclusion: 重构优势作为统一风险度量优于传统重构鲁棒性，能够一致地捕捉多种攻击类型的风险，为差分隐私数据管理系统提供更可靠的风险评估框架和校准方法。

title: Frequency-Modulated Visual Restoration for Matryoshka Large Multimodal Models
summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) struggle to adapt varying computational budgets due to numerous visual tokens. Previous methods attempted to reduce the number of visual tokens before or within LLMs. However, these strategies inevitably result in the loss of visual semantic. To address these issues, we introduce FMVR, a plug-and-play and extremely simple Frequency-Modulated Visual Restoration strategy to boost the reasoning ability of LMMs under visual token reduction. Specifically, FMVR disentangles the visual representation of fewer visual tokens into low- and high-frequency components through AvgPool and MaxPool. The derived frequencies are subsequently modulated using lightweight learnable parameters. The high-frequency from AvgPool acts as a saliency filter to enhance saliency visual semantics, while the low-frequency from MaxPool acts as an anti-saliency filter to strengthen weak visual semantics. It enables the preservation of visual semantics dominated by few visual tokens and the restoration of diluted visual semantics. Additionally, we inject FMVR into Matryoshka Representation Learning to learn coarse-to-fine visual token sets, thus enabling to elastically adjust the number of visual tokens during inference while maintaining comparable performance. Experiments across 10 image-based and 4 video-based bench marks demonstrate that FMVR-LLaVA reduce the FLOPs of LLaVA-1.5-7B by 89%, while maintaining almost 100% of the original accuracy. The code will be open.

AI.tldr: FMVR是一种即插即用的频率调制视觉恢复策略，通过分离低频和高频视觉语义来提升大模型在视觉token减少情况下的推理能力，同时结合嵌套表示学习实现弹性token数量调整。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型在处理大量视觉token时面临计算资源适应性问题，现有减少视觉token的方法会导致视觉语义信息丢失，需要一种能够在减少token的同时保持视觉语义完整性的解决方案。
AI.method: FMVR通过AvgPool和MaxPool将少量视觉token的表示分解为低频和高频分量，使用轻量级可学习参数进行调制。高频分量作为显著性滤波器增强显著视觉语义，低频分量作为反显著性滤波器增强弱视觉语义。结合嵌套表示学习实现从粗到细的视觉token集学习。
AI.result: 在10个图像基准和4个视频基准上的实验表明，FMVR-LLaVA将LLaVA-1.5-7B的FLOPs减少了89%，同时保持了接近100%的原始准确率。
AI.conclusion: FMVR是一种简单有效的策略，能够在显著减少计算开销的同时保持视觉语义完整性，为大型多模态模型在不同计算预算下的部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Jailbreak Scaling Laws for Large Language Models: Polynomial-Exponential Crossover
summary: Adversarial attacks can reliably steer safety-aligned large language models toward unsafe behavior. Empirically, we find that adversarial prompt-injection attacks can amplify attack success rate from the slow polynomial growth observed without injection to exponential growth with the number of inference-time samples. To explain this phenomenon, we propose a theoretical generative model of proxy language in terms of a spin-glass system operating in a replica-symmetry-breaking regime, where generations are drawn from the associated Gibbs measure and a subset of low-energy, size-biased clusters is designated unsafe. Within this framework, we analyze prompt injection-based jailbreaking. Short injected prompts correspond to a weak magnetic field aligned towards unsafe cluster centers and yield a power-law scaling of attack success rate with the number of inference-time samples, while long injected prompts, i.e., strong magnetic field, yield exponential scaling. We derive these behaviors analytically and confirm them empirically on large language models. This transition between two regimes is due to the appearance of an ordered phase in the spin chain under a strong magnetic field, which suggests that the injected jailbreak prompt enhances adversarial order in the language model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个理论框架，将对抗性提示注入攻击的成功率缩放行为解释为自旋玻璃系统中的相变现象，短提示导致成功率幂律增长，长提示导致指数增长。
AI.motivation: 对抗性攻击能够可靠地引导安全对齐的大型语言模型产生不安全行为。实证研究发现，对抗性提示注入攻击可以将攻击成功率从无注入时的缓慢多项式增长放大为指数增长。需要理论解释这种缩放行为的根本机制。
AI.method: 提出一个基于自旋玻璃系统的理论生成模型，将语言生成过程建模为在复制对称破缺机制下运行的Gibbs测度采样。将不安全行为对应为低能、尺寸偏置的聚类中心。分析提示注入攻击：短提示对应弱磁场指向不安全聚类中心，长提示对应强磁场。通过理论推导和大型语言模型上的实证验证相结合。
AI.result: 理论分析表明：短注入提示导致攻击成功率随推理样本数呈幂律缩放，长注入提示导致指数缩放。这种相变是由于强磁场下自旋链中出现有序相，表明注入的越狱提示增强了语言模型中的对抗性有序性。实证结果与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性提示注入攻击的成功率缩放行为可以通过自旋玻璃理论框架解释为相变现象。短提示和长提示分别对应不同的缩放机制，这种转变源于强磁场诱导的有序相出现。该理论为理解语言模型对抗攻击的动力学提供了新的视角。

title: Privacy in ERP Systems: Behavioral Models of Developers and Consultants
comment: This paper was presented at the 20th International Conference on Risks and Security of Internet and Systems (CRISIS'2025) and will appear in its post-proceedings. This is authors' copy
summary:
Applications like Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems have become an indispensable part of the corporate digital infrastructure. These systems store sensitive data about customers, suppliers, and employees, and thus companies have to process these data in accordance with applicable regulations like the GDPR (the EU General Data Protection Regulation). This can be challenging due to a variety of reasons. For example, prior research has shown that developers sometimes lack knowledge about privacy.
  In this work, we focus on privacy in ERP systems in the context of an international consultancy firm. We investigate the privacy awareness regarding privacy-by-design and data minimization of two important populations: developers of ERP systems and managers and consultants responsible for services related to ERP systems. Applying thematic analysis, we elicit privacy behavioral models of these two populations using Fogg's Behavioral Model (FBM) framework. Our findings provide a means to stimulate more adequate privacy-related behaviors for developers and consultants.

AI.tldr: 该研究聚焦于ERP系统中的隐私问题，调查了开发者和顾问/经理的隐私意识，并应用Fogg行为模型框架分析他们的隐私行为模式，旨在促进更适当的隐私相关行为。
AI.motivation: ERP系统存储敏感数据，企业需遵守GDPR等法规，但开发者可能缺乏隐私知识，因此需要研究ERP系统中的隐私意识现状。
AI.method: 在国际咨询公司背景下，调查ERP系统开发者和负责ERP相关服务的经理/顾问的隐私意识，特别关注隐私设计和数据最小化原则，应用主题分析和Fogg行为模型框架来构建隐私行为模型。
AI.result: 研究揭示了两个重要群体的隐私行为模型，为促进开发者和顾问更适当的隐私相关行为提供了方法和依据。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为激励ERP系统开发者和顾问采取更充分的隐私保护行为提供了手段，有助于改善ERP系统中的隐私实践。

title: When Slots Compete: Slot Merging in Object-Centric Learning
summary: Slot-based object-centric learning represents an image as a set of latent slots with a decoder that combines them into an image or features. The decoder specifies how slots are combined into an output, but the slot set is typically fixed: the number of slots is chosen upfront and slots are only refined. This can lead to multiple slots competing for overlapping regions of the same entity rather than focusing on distinct regions. We introduce slot merging: a drop-in, lightweight operation on the slot set that merges overlapping slots during training. We quantify overlap with a Soft-IoU score between slot-attention maps and combine selected pairs via a barycentric update that preserves gradient flow. Merging follows a fixed policy, with the decision threshold inferred from overlap statistics, requiring no additional learnable modules. Integrated into the established feature-reconstruction pipeline of DINOSAUR, the proposed method improves object factorization and mask quality, surpassing other adaptive methods in object discovery and segmentation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出slot合并方法，通过Soft-IoU评估slot重叠度，使用重心更新合并重叠slot，无需额外可学习模块，在DINOSAUR框架中提升对象分解和掩码质量
AI.motivation: 传统基于slot的对象中心学习方法中，slot数量固定且只能被细化，导致多个slot可能竞争同一实体的重叠区域，而不是专注于不同区域，限制了对象分解效果
AI.method: 引入slot合并操作：1) 使用Soft-IoU评分量化slot注意力图之间的重叠度；2) 通过重心更新合并选定的slot对，保持梯度流；3) 采用固定策略，从重叠统计中推断决策阈值，无需额外可学习模块；4) 集成到DINOSAUR的特征重建流程中
AI.result: 方法改善了对象分解和掩码质量，在对象发现和分割基准测试中超越了其他自适应方法
AI.conclusion: slot合并是一种轻量级的即插即用操作，能够有效解决slot重叠竞争问题，提升基于slot的对象中心学习性能，无需增加模型复杂度

title: CreativeBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Machine Creativity via Self-Evolving Challenges
summary: The saturation of high-quality pre-training data has shifted research focus toward evolutionary systems capable of continuously generating novel artifacts, leading to the success of AlphaEvolve. However, the progress of such systems is hindered by the lack of rigorous, quantitative evaluation. To tackle this challenge, we introduce CreativeBench, a benchmark for evaluating machine creativity in code generation, grounded in a classical cognitive framework. Comprising two subsets -- CreativeBench-Combo and CreativeBench-Explore -- the benchmark targets combinatorial and exploratory creativity through an automated pipeline utilizing reverse engineering and self-play. By leveraging executable code, CreativeBench objectively distinguishes creativity from hallucination via a unified metric defined as the product of quality and novelty. Our analysis of state-of-the-art models reveals distinct behaviors: (1) scaling significantly improves combinatorial creativity but yields diminishing returns for exploration; (2) larger models exhibit ``convergence-by-scaling,'' becoming more correct but less divergent; and (3) reasoning capabilities primarily benefit constrained exploration rather than combination. Finally, we propose EvoRePE, a plug-and-play inference-time steering strategy that internalizes evolutionary search patterns to consistently enhance machine creativity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CreativeBench基准测试，用于量化评估代码生成中的机器创造力，包含组合和探索两个子集，并引入EvoRePE推理时引导策略提升创造力。
AI.motivation: 高质量预训练数据饱和后，研究转向能够持续生成新颖产物的进化系统（如AlphaEvolve），但这类系统缺乏严谨的量化评估阻碍了进展。
AI.method: 提出CreativeBench基准测试，基于经典认知框架，包含CreativeBench-Combo（组合创造力）和CreativeBench-Explore（探索创造力）两个子集，通过逆向工程和自对弈的自动化流程，利用可执行代码客观区分创造力与幻觉，以质量和新颖度的乘积作为统一度量标准。
AI.result: 对最先进模型的分析发现：（1）模型缩放显著提升组合创造力但对探索的收益递减；（2）更大模型呈现"缩放收敛"现象，变得更正确但更少发散；（3）推理能力主要受益于受限探索而非组合。提出的EvoRePE推理时引导策略能持续增强机器创造力。
AI.conclusion: CreativeBench为机器创造力提供了严谨的量化评估框架，揭示了模型缩放对创造力的复杂影响，提出的EvoRePE策略能有效提升创造力表现，为进化系统的评估和发展提供了重要工具。

title: Teleodynamic Learning a new Paradigm For Interpretable AI
summary: We introduce Teleodynamic Learning, a new paradigm for machine learning in which learning is not the minimization of a fixed objective, but the emergence and stabilization of functional organization under constraint. Inspired by living systems, this framework treats intelligence as the coupled evolution of three quantities: what a system can represent, how it adapts its parameters, and which changes its internal resources can sustain. We formalize learning as a constrained dynamical process with two interacting timescales: inner dynamics for continuous parameter adaptation and outer dynamics for discrete structural change, linked by an endogenous resource variable that both shapes and is shaped by the trajectory. This perspective reveals three phenomena that standard optimization does not naturally capture: self-stabilization without externally imposed stopping rules, phase-structured learning dynamics that move from under-structuring through teleodynamic growth to over-structuring, and convergence guarantees grounded in information geometry rather than convexity. We instantiate the framework in the Distinction Engine (DE11), a teleodynamic learner grounded in Spencer-Brown's Laws of Form, information geometry, and tropical optimization. On standard benchmarks, DE11 achieves 93.3 percent test accuracy on IRIS, 92.6 percent on WINE, and 94.7 percent on Breast Cancer, while producing interpretable logical rules that arise endogenously from the learning dynamics rather than being imposed by hand. More broadly, Teleodynamic Learning unifies regularization, architecture search, and resource-bounded inference within a single principle: learning as the co-evolution of structure, parameters, and resources under constraint. This opens a thermodynamically grounded route to adaptive, interpretable, and self-organizing AI.

AI.tldr: 提出Teleodynamic Learning新范式，将学习视为约束下功能组织的涌现与稳定，而非固定目标的最小化。基于Spencer-Brown的《形式法则》、信息几何和热带优化，实现了Distinction Engine (DE11)模型，在标准数据集上取得优异性能并产生可解释逻辑规则。
AI.motivation: 受生命系统启发，传统机器学习将学习视为固定目标的最小化，无法自然捕捉自稳定、阶段性学习动态等现象。需要新范式将智能视为表示能力、参数适应和内部资源可持续变化的三者耦合演化。
AI.method: 将学习形式化为具有两个相互作用时间尺度的约束动力学过程：内部动力学用于连续参数适应，外部动力学用于离散结构变化，通过内源性资源变量连接。基于Spencer-Brown的《形式法则》、信息几何和热带优化，实现了Distinction Engine (DE11)具体模型。
AI.result: DE11在标准基准测试中取得优异性能：IRIS数据集93.3%测试准确率，WINE数据集92.6%，乳腺癌数据集94.7%。同时产生从学习动态内源性涌现的可解释逻辑规则，而非手工强加。
AI.conclusion: Teleodynamic Learning将正则化、架构搜索和资源受限推理统一于单一原则下：学习作为结构、参数和资源在约束下的协同演化。这为自适应、可解释和自组织AI开辟了热力学基础路径。

title: Radiometric fingerprinting of object surfaces using mobile laser scanning and semantic 3D road space models
summary: Although semantic 3D city models are internationally available and becoming increasingly detailed, the incorporation of material information remains largely untapped. However, a structured representation of materials and their physical properties could substantially broaden the application spectrum and analytical capabilities for urban digital twins. At the same time, the growing number of repeated mobile laser scans of cities and their street spaces yields a wealth of observations influenced by the material characteristics of the corresponding surfaces. To leverage this information, we propose radiometric fingerprints of object surfaces by grouping LiDAR observations reflected from the same semantic object under varying distances, incident angles, environmental conditions, sensors, and scanning campaigns. Our study demonstrates how 312.4 million individual beams acquired across four campaigns using five LiDAR sensors on the Audi Autonomous Driving Dataset (A2D2) vehicle can be automatically associated with 6368 individual objects of the semantic 3D city model. The model comprises a comprehensive and semantic representation of four inner-city streets at Level of Detail (LOD) 3 with centimeter-level accuracy. It is based on the CityGML 3.0 standard and enables fine-grained sub-differentiation of objects. The extracted radiometric fingerprints for object surfaces reveal recurring intra-class patterns that indicate class-dominant materials. The semantic model, the method implementations, and the developed geodatabase solution 3DSensorDB are released under: https://github.com/tum-gis/sensordb

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种通过LiDAR观测提取物体表面辐射度指纹的方法，将多传感器、多时相的激光扫描数据与语义3D城市模型关联，用于识别城市物体的材料特性。
AI.motivation: 尽管语义3D城市模型日益详细，但材料信息的整合仍然不足。材料及其物理特性的结构化表示可以显著扩展城市数字孪生的应用范围和分析能力。同时，城市重复移动激光扫描产生了大量受材料特性影响的观测数据。
AI.method: 提出辐射度指纹方法：将来自同一语义物体在不同距离、入射角、环境条件、传感器和扫描任务下的LiDAR观测分组。使用奥迪自动驾驶数据集（A2D2）车辆上的五个LiDAR传感器，在四次扫描任务中获取3.124亿条光束，自动关联到语义3D城市模型中的6368个个体对象。
AI.result: 提取的物体表面辐射度指纹显示出重复的类内模式，表明类别主导材料。模型基于CityGML 3.0标准，包含四条内城街道的厘米级精度LOD 3语义表示，支持细粒度子分化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功将大规模LiDAR观测与语义3D城市模型关联，为材料识别提供了新途径。语义模型、方法实现和开发的3DSensorDB地理数据库解决方案已开源发布。

title: Multilingual Financial Fraud Detection Using Machine Learning and Transformer Models: A Bangla-English Study
summary: Financial fraud detection has emerged as a critical research challenge amid the rapid expansion of digital financial platforms. Although machine learning approaches have demonstrated strong performance in identifying fraudulent activities, most existing research focuses exclusively on English-language data, limiting applicability to multilingual contexts. Bangla (Bengali), despite being spoken by over 250 million people, remains largely unexplored in this domain. In this work, we investigate financial fraud detection in a multilingual Bangla-English setting using a dataset comprising legitimate and fraudulent financial messages. We evaluate classical machine learning models (Logistic Regression, Linear SVM, and Ensemble classifiers) using TF-IDF features alongside transformer-based architectures. Experimental results using 5-fold stratified cross-validation demonstrate that Linear SVM achieves the best performance with 91.59 percent accuracy and 91.30 percent F1 score, outperforming the transformer model (89.49 percent accuracy, 88.88 percent F1) by approximately 2 percentage points. The transformer exhibits higher fraud recall (94.19 percent) but suffers from elevated false positive rates. Exploratory analysis reveals distinctive patterns: scam messages are longer, contain urgency-inducing terms, and frequently include URLs (32 percent) and phone numbers (97 percent), while legitimate messages feature transactional confirmations and specific currency references. Our findings highlight that classical machine learning with well-crafted features remains competitive for multilingual fraud detection, while also underscoring the challenges posed by linguistic diversity, code-mixing, and low-resource language constraints.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了孟加拉语-英语多语言环境下的金融欺诈检测，发现传统机器学习模型（线性SVM）在准确率和F1分数上优于Transformer模型，同时分析了欺诈消息的典型特征模式。
AI.motivation: 金融欺诈检测在数字金融平台快速扩张中成为关键研究挑战。现有研究大多专注于英语数据，限制了在多语言环境中的应用。孟加拉语（孟加拉语）虽然拥有超过2.5亿使用者，但在该领域仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 研究使用包含合法和欺诈性金融消息的数据集，在孟加拉语-英语多语言环境下进行金融欺诈检测。评估了传统机器学习模型（逻辑回归、线性SVM和集成分类器）使用TF-IDF特征，以及基于Transformer的架构。采用5折分层交叉验证进行实验。
AI.result: 线性SVM获得最佳性能：91.59%准确率和91.30% F1分数，优于Transformer模型（89.49%准确率，88.88% F1）约2个百分点。Transformer模型具有更高的欺诈召回率（94.19%），但假阳性率较高。探索性分析显示：欺诈消息通常更长、包含紧急诱导词汇、频繁包含URL（32%）和电话号码（97%），而合法消息则包含交易确认和特定货币引用。
AI.conclusion: 精心设计的特征与传统机器学习在多语言欺诈检测中仍具有竞争力，同时凸显了语言多样性、代码混合和低资源语言约束带来的挑战。

title: Towards Automated Initial Probe Placement in Transthoracic Teleultrasound Using Human Mesh and Skeleton Recovery
summary: Cardiac and lung ultrasound are technically demanding because operators must identify patient-specific intercostal acoustic windows and then navigate between standard views by adjusting probe position, rotation, and force across different imaging planes. These challenges are amplified in teleultrasound when a novice or robot faces the difficult task of first placing the probe on the patient without in-person expert assistance. We present a framework for automating Patient registration and anatomy-informed Initial Probe placement Guidance (PIPG) using only RGB images from a calibrated camera. The novice first captures the patient using the camera on a mixed reality (MR) head-mounted display (HMD). An edge server then infers a patient-specific body-surface and skeleton model, with spatial smoothing across multiple views. Using bony landmarks from the predicted skeleton, we estimate the intercostal region and project the guidance back onto the reconstructed body surface. To validate the framework, we overlaid the reconstructed body mesh and the virtual probe pose guidance across multiple transthoracic echocardiography scan planes in situ and measured the quantitative placement error. Pilot experiments with healthy volunteers suggest that the proposed probe placement prediction and MR guidance yield consistent initial placement within anatomical variability acceptable for teleultrasound setup

AI.tldr: 提出基于RGB图像的自动化患者注册与解剖引导初始探头放置框架，用于远程超声检查，通过混合现实头显提供虚拟探头姿态引导
AI.motivation: 心脏和肺部超声检查技术要求高，操作者需要识别患者特定的肋间声窗并在不同成像平面间导航。在远程超声中，新手或机器人面临在没有专家现场协助的情况下将探头放置在患者身上的困难任务
AI.method: 使用混合现实头戴显示器的RGB摄像头采集患者图像，边缘服务器推断患者特定的体表和骨骼模型，通过骨骼标志点估计肋间区域，并将引导信息投影到重建的体表上
AI.result: 通过健康志愿者实验验证，提出的探头放置预测和混合现实引导能够实现一致的初始放置，误差在解剖学可接受的变异性范围内，适用于远程超声设置
AI.conclusion: 该框架为远程超声中的自动化患者注册和初始探头放置提供了一种有效的解决方案，减少了操作者的技术要求，提高了远程超声检查的可行性

title: AdaFuse: Accelerating Dynamic Adapter Inference via Token-Level Pre-Gating and Fused Kernel Optimization
comment: Accepted to AAAI 2026. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2405.17741
summary: The integration of dynamic, sparse structures like Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with parameter-efficient adapters (e.g., LoRA) is a powerful technique for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). However, this architectural enhancement comes at a steep cost: despite minimal increases in computational load, the inference latency often skyrockets, leading to decoding speeds slowing by over 2.5 times. Through a fine-grained performance analysis, we pinpoint the primary bottleneck not in the computation itself, but in the severe overhead from fragmented, sequential CUDA kernel launches required for conventional dynamic routing. To address this challenge, we introduce AdaFuse, a framework built on a tight co-design between the algorithm and the underlying hardware system to enable efficient dynamic adapter execution. Departing from conventional layer-wise or block-wise routing, AdaFuse employs a token-level pre-gating strategy, which makes a single, global routing decision for all adapter layers before a token is processed. This "decide-once, apply-everywhere" approach effectively staticizes the execution path for each token, creating an opportunity for holistic optimization. We capitalize on this by developing a custom CUDA kernel that performs a fused switching operation, merging the parameters of all selected LoRA adapters into the backbone model in a single, efficient pass. Experimental results on popular open-source LLMs show that AdaFuse achieves accuracy on par with state-of-the-art dynamic adapters while drastically cutting decoding latency by a factor of over 2.4x, thereby bridging the gap between model capability and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: AdaFuse通过令牌级预门控策略和融合CUDA内核，解决了动态稀疏结构（如MoE）与参数高效适配器（如LoRA）集成时推理延迟激增的问题，将解码速度提升2.4倍以上。
AI.motivation: 动态稀疏结构（如MoE）与参数高效适配器（如LoRA）的集成能增强大语言模型能力，但导致推理延迟激增（解码速度降低2.5倍以上）。主要瓶颈不是计算本身，而是传统动态路由所需的碎片化、顺序CUDA内核启动带来的严重开销。
AI.method: 提出AdaFuse框架，基于算法与底层硬件系统的紧密协同设计。采用令牌级预门控策略，在处理令牌前做出单一全局路由决策，静态化每个令牌的执行路径。开发定制CUDA内核，执行融合切换操作，将所选LoRA适配器参数一次性高效合并到骨干模型中。
AI.result: 在流行的开源大语言模型上实验表明，AdaFuse在保持与最先进动态适配器相当准确度的同时，将解码延迟大幅降低2.4倍以上，弥合了模型能力与推理效率之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: AdaFuse通过算法-硬件协同设计，解决了动态适配器执行效率低下的核心问题，实现了准确性与推理效率的平衡，为动态稀疏结构与参数高效适配器的集成提供了高效解决方案。

title: KEPo: Knowledge Evolution Poison on Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted in the ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW 2026)
summary: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) constructs the Knowledge Graph (KG) from external databases to enhance the timeliness and accuracy of Large Language Model (LLM) generations.However,this reliance on external data introduces new attack surfaces.Attackers can inject poisoned texts into databases to manipulate LLMs into producing harmful target responses for attacker-chosen queries.Existing research primarily focuses on attacking conventional RAG systems.However,such methods are ineffective against GraphRAG.This robustness derives from the KG abstraction of GraphRAG,which reorganizes injected text into a graph before retrieval,thereby enabling the LLM to reason based on the restructured context instead of raw poisoned passages.To expose latent security vulnerabilities in GraphRAG,we propose Knowledge Evolution Poison (KEPo),a novel poisoning attack method specifically designed for GraphRAG.For each target query,KEPo first generates a toxic event containing poisoned knowledge based on the target answer.By fabricating event backgrounds and forging knowledge evolution paths from original facts to the toxic event,it then poisons the KG and misleads the LLM into treating the poisoned knowledge as the final result.In multi-target attack scenarios,KEPo further connects multiple attack corpora,enabling their poisoned knowledge to mutually reinforce while expanding the scale of poisoned communities,thereby amplifying attack effectiveness.Experimental results across multiple datasets demonstrate that KEPo achieves state-of-the-art attack success rates for both single-target and multi-target attacks,significantly outperforming previous methods.

AI.tldr: KEPo是一种针对GraphRAG的新型知识图投毒攻击方法，通过伪造事件背景和知识演化路径，在单目标和多目标攻击中实现最先进的攻击成功率
AI.motivation: GraphRAG通过从外部数据库构建知识图来增强LLM的时效性和准确性，但这种对外部数据的依赖引入了新的攻击面。现有攻击方法主要针对传统RAG系统，对GraphRAG无效，因为其知识图抽象能够重组注入文本。需要揭示GraphRAG中潜在的安全漏洞
AI.method: KEPo（知识演化投毒）方法：1）为目标查询生成包含投毒知识的有毒事件；2）伪造事件背景和从原始事实到有毒事件的知识演化路径；3）投毒知识图，误导LLM将投毒知识视为最终结果；4）在多目标攻击中，连接多个攻击语料，使投毒知识相互增强并扩大投毒社区规模
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验结果表明，KEPo在单目标和多目标攻击中都实现了最先进的攻击成功率，显著优于先前方法
AI.conclusion: GraphRAG虽然通过知识图抽象增强了对抗传统RAG攻击的鲁棒性，但仍存在潜在安全漏洞。KEPo方法通过伪造知识演化路径有效攻击GraphRAG，揭示了此类系统的安全风险，需要开发相应的防御机制

title: Fair Learning for Bias Mitigation and Quality Optimization in Paper Recommendation
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2602.22438
summary: Despite frequent double-blind review, demographic biases of authors still disadvantage the underrepresented groups. We present Fair-PaperRec, a MultiLayer Perceptron (MLP)-based model that addresses demographic disparities in post-review paper acceptance decisions while maintaining high-quality requirements. Our methodology penalizes demographic disparities while preserving quality through intersectional criteria (e.g., race, country) and a customized fairness loss, in contrast to heuristic approaches. Evaluations using conference data from ACM Special Interest Group on Computer-Human Interaction (SIGCHI), Designing Interactive Systems (DIS), and Intelligent User Interfaces (IUI) indicate a 42.03% increase in underrepresented group participation and a 3.16% improvement in overall utility, indicating that diversity promotion does not compromise academic rigor and supports equity-focused peer review solutions.

AI.tldr: Fair-PaperRec：基于MLP的模型，通过定制化公平损失函数解决审稿过程中的作者人口统计偏见，在保持学术质量的同时提升代表性不足群体的参与度
AI.motivation: 尽管采用双盲评审，作者的人口统计特征偏见仍然使代表性不足群体处于不利地位。需要开发能够同时保证公平性和学术质量的审稿决策模型
AI.method: 提出Fair-PaperRec模型，基于多层感知机(MLP)，通过交叉性标准（种族、国家等）和定制化公平损失函数来惩罚人口统计差异，同时保持论文质量要求
AI.result: 在ACM SIGCHI、DIS和IUI会议数据上的评估显示：代表性不足群体参与度提升42.03%，整体效用提高3.16%，表明多样性提升不会损害学术严谨性
AI.conclusion: Fair-PaperRec证明了在保持学术质量的同时促进公平性的可行性，为面向公平的同行评审解决方案提供了支持，表明多样性促进与学术严谨性可以共存

title: Relaxed Efficient Acquisition of Context and Temporal Features
summary: In many biomedical applications, measurements are not freely available at inference time: each laboratory test, imaging modality, or assessment incurs financial cost, time burden, or patient risk. Longitudinal active feature acquisition (LAFA) seeks to optimize predictive performance under such constraints by adaptively selecting measurements over time, yet the problem remains inherently challenging due to temporally coupled decisions (missed early measurements cannot be revisited, and acquisition choices influence all downstream predictions). Moreover, real-world clinical workflows typically begin with an initial onboarding phase, during which relatively stable contextual descriptors (e.g., demographics or baseline characteristics) are collected once and subsequently condition longitudinal decision-making. Despite its practical importance, the efficient selection of onboarding context has not been studied jointly with temporally adaptive acquisition. We therefore propose REACT (Relaxed Efficient Acquisition of Context and Temporal features), an end-to-end differentiable framework that simultaneously optimizes (i) selection of onboarding contextual descriptors and (ii) adaptive feature--time acquisition plans for longitudinal measurements under cost constraints. REACT employs a Gumbel--Sigmoid relaxation with straight-through estimation to enable gradient-based optimization over discrete acquisition masks, allowing direct backpropagation from prediction loss and acquisition cost. Across real-world longitudinal health and behavioral datasets, REACT achieves improved predictive performance at lower acquisition costs compared to existing longitudinal acquisition baselines, demonstrating the benefit of modeling onboarding and temporally coupled acquisition within a unified optimization framework.

AI.tldr: REACT框架联合优化初始上下文特征选择与纵向时序特征采集，通过可微分松弛实现端到端优化，在成本约束下提升预测性能
AI.motivation: 生物医学应用中测量获取存在成本、时间和风险限制，纵向主动特征采集面临时序耦合决策挑战，且实际临床工作流包含初始上下文收集阶段，但现有方法未联合优化上下文选择与时序自适应采集
AI.method: 提出REACT端到端可微分框架，使用Gumbel-Sigmoid松弛与直通估计实现离散采集掩码的梯度优化，同时优化(i)初始上下文描述符选择和(ii)成本约束下的纵向测量自适应特征-时间采集计划
AI.result: 在真实世界纵向健康和数据集上，REACT相比现有纵向采集基线方法，以更低的采集成本实现了更好的预测性能
AI.conclusion: 在统一优化框架中建模初始上下文收集和时序耦合采集具有显著优势，REACT框架能有效平衡预测性能与采集成本约束

title: Exponential-Family Membership Inference: From LiRA and RMIA to BaVarIA
summary: Membership inference attacks (MIAs) are becoming standard tools for auditing the privacy of machine learning models. The leading attacks -- LiRA (Carlini et al., 2022) and RMIA (Zarifzadeh et al., 2024) -- appear to use distinct scoring strategies, while the recently proposed BASE (Lassila et al., 2025) was shown to be equivalent to RMIA, making it difficult for practitioners to choose among them. We show that all three are instances of a single exponential-family log-likelihood ratio framework, differing only in their distributional assumptions and the number of parameters estimated per data point. This unification reveals a hierarchy (BASE1-4) that connects RMIA and LiRA as endpoints of a spectrum of increasing model complexity. Within this framework, we identify variance estimation as the key bottleneck at small shadow-model budgets and propose BaVarIA, a Bayesian variance inference attack that replaces threshold-based parameter switching with conjugate normal-inverse-gamma priors. BaVarIA yields a Student-t predictive (BaVarIA-t) or a Gaussian with stabilized variance (BaVarIA-n), providing stable performance without additional hyperparameter tuning. Across 12 datasets and 7 shadow-model budgets, BaVarIA matches or improves upon LiRA and RMIA, with the largest gains in the practically important low-shadow-model and offline regimes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一个统一框架，将LiRA、RMIA和BASE三种成员推理攻击方法统一为指数族对数似然比框架的不同实例，并基于此提出了BaVarIA攻击方法，在低影子模型预算下表现更优。
AI.motivation: 当前存在多种成员推理攻击方法（LiRA、RMIA、BASE），它们看似使用不同的评分策略，但实际关系不明确，使得实践者难以选择。需要建立一个统一框架来理解这些方法之间的关系，并解决在小影子模型预算下性能下降的问题。
AI.method: 1. 提出指数族对数似然比统一框架，将LiRA、RMIA和BASE视为该框架下不同分布假设和参数估计数量的实例；2. 识别方差估计是小影子模型预算下的关键瓶颈；3. 提出BaVarIA攻击方法，使用共轭正态-逆伽马先验替代阈值参数切换，产生Student-t预测（BaVarIA-t）或方差稳定的高斯分布（BaVarIA-n）。
AI.result: 在12个数据集和7种影子模型预算下，BaVarIA匹配或优于LiRA和RMIA，在低影子模型预算和离线场景中提升最显著。统一框架揭示了RMIA和LiRA作为复杂度谱系的两个端点，并通过BASE1-4层次连接。
AI.conclusion: 所有主要成员推理攻击方法都可以统一到同一指数族框架下，方差估计是小预算下的关键瓶颈。BaVarIA通过贝叶斯方差推断提供了稳定性能，无需额外超参数调优，在实用场景中表现优异。

title: Hierarchical Granularity Alignment and State Space Modeling for Robust Multimodal AU Detection in the Wild
summary: Facial Action Unit (AU) detection in in-the-wild environments remains a formidable challenge due to severe spatial-temporal heterogeneity, unconstrained poses, and complex audio-visual dependencies. While recent multimodal approaches have made progress, they often rely on capacity-limited encoders and shallow fusion mechanisms that fail to capture fine-grained semantic shifts and ultra-long temporal contexts. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel multimodal framework driven by Hierarchical Granularity Alignment and State Space Models.Specifically, we leverage powerful foundation models, namely DINOv2 and WavLM, to extract robust and high-fidelity visual and audio representations, effectively replacing traditional feature extractors. To handle extreme facial variations, our Hierarchical Granularity Alignment module dynamically aligns global facial semantics with fine-grained local active patches. Furthermore, we overcome the receptive field limitations of conventional temporal convolutional networks by introducing a Vision-Mamba architecture. This approach enables temporal modeling with O(N) linear complexity, effectively capturing ultra-long-range dynamics without performance degradation. A novel asymmetric cross-attention mechanism is also introduced to deeply synchronize paralinguistic audio cues with subtle visual movements.Extensive experiments on the challenging Aff-Wild2 dataset demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving state-of-the-art performance. Notably, this framework secured top rankings in the AU Detection track of the 10th Affective Behavior Analysis in-the-wild Competition.

AI.tldr: 提出基于层次粒度对齐和状态空间模型的多模态框架，用于野外环境下的面部动作单元检测，显著提升性能并取得竞赛第一名
AI.motivation: 野外环境下的面部动作单元检测面临空间-时间异质性、无约束姿态和复杂视听依赖等挑战，现有方法受限于容量有限的编码器和浅层融合机制，无法捕捉细粒度语义变化和超长时域上下文
AI.method: 使用DINOv2和WavLM基础模型提取鲁棒的视听表征；提出层次粒度对齐模块动态对齐全局面部语义与细粒度局部活跃区域；引入Vision-Mamba架构实现线性复杂度的时域建模；设计非对称交叉注意力机制深度同步副语言音频线索与细微视觉运动
AI.result: 在Aff-Wild2数据集上显著超越现有基线，达到最先进性能；在第十届野外情感行为分析竞赛的面部动作单元检测赛道中获得最高排名
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过层次粒度对齐和状态空间模型有效解决了野外环境下面部动作单元检测的挑战，为多模态情感分析提供了新的解决方案

title: Prototype-Based Knowledge Guidance for Fine-Grained Structured Radiology Reporting
summary: Structured radiology reporting promises faster, more consistent communication than free text, but automation remains difficult as models must make many fine-grained, discrete decisions about rare findings and attributes from limited structured supervision. In contrast, free-text reports are produced at scale in routine care and implicitly encode fine-grained, image-linked information through detailed descriptions. To leverage this unstructured knowledge, we propose ProtoSR, an approach for injecting free-text information into structured report population. First, we introduce an automatic extraction pipeline that uses an instruction-tuned LLM to mine 80k+ MIMIC-CXR studies and build a multimodal knowledge base aligned with a structured reporting template, representing each answer option with a visual prototype. Using this knowledge base, ProtoSR is trained to retrieve prototypes relevant for the current image-question pair and augment the model predictions through a prototype-conditioned residual, providing a data-driven second opinion that selectively corrects predictions. On the Rad-ReStruct benchmark, ProtoSR achieves state-of-the-art results, with the largest improvements on detailed attribute questions, demonstrating the value of integrating free-text derived signal for fine-grained image understanding.

AI.tldr: ProtoSR：通过从自由文本报告中提取知识构建视觉原型库，利用原型检索增强结构化放射报告生成，在细粒度属性问题上取得SOTA效果
AI.motivation: 结构化放射报告比自由文本报告更快速、一致，但自动化困难，因为模型需要基于有限的结构化监督做出许多细粒度、离散的决策。而自由文本报告在常规护理中大规模产生，通过详细描述隐式编码了细粒度、与图像关联的信息。
AI.method: 1. 使用指令调优的LLM从80k+ MIMIC-CXR研究中自动提取信息，构建与结构化报告模板对齐的多模态知识库，为每个答案选项创建视觉原型。2. 训练ProtoSR检索当前图像-问题对相关的原型，通过原型条件残差增强模型预测，提供数据驱动的第二意见，选择性修正预测。
AI.result: 在Rad-ReStruct基准测试中，ProtoSR实现了最先进的结果，在详细属性问题上改进最大，证明了整合自由文本衍生信号对细粒度图像理解的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过从自由文本报告中提取知识构建视觉原型库，可以有效增强结构化放射报告生成，特别是在细粒度属性识别方面，为利用非结构化知识改进结构化任务提供了有效途径。

title: Ensuring Safety in Automated Mechanical Ventilation through Offline Reinforcement Learning and Digital Twin Verification
summary: Mechanical ventilation (MV) is a life-saving intervention for patients with acute respiratory failure (ARF) in the ICU. However, inappropriate ventilator settings could cause ventilator-induced lung injury (VILI). Also, clinicians workload is shown to be directly linked to patient outcomes. Hence, MV should be personalized and automated to improve patient outcomes. Previous attempts to incorporate personalization and automation in MV include traditional supervised learning and offline reinforcement learning (RL) approaches, which often neglect temporal dependencies and rely excessively on mortality-based rewards. As a result, early stage physiological deterioration and the risk of VILI are not adequately captured. To address these limitations, we propose Transformer-based Conservative Q-Learning (T-CQL), a novel offline RL framework that integrates a Transformer encoder for effective temporal modeling of patient dynamics, conservative adaptive regularization based on uncertainty quantification to ensure safety, and consistency regularization for robust decision-making. We build a clinically informed reward function that incorporates indicators of VILI and a score for severity of patients illness. Also, previous work predominantly uses Fitted Q-Evaluation (FQE) for RL policy evaluation on static offline data, which is less responsive to dynamic environmental changes and susceptible to distribution shifts. To overcome these evaluation limitations, interactive digital twins of ARF patients were used for online "at the bedside" evaluation. Our results demonstrate that T-CQL consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art offline RL methodologies, providing safer and more effective ventilatory adjustments. Our framework demonstrates the potential of Transformer-based models combined with conservative RL strategies as a decision support tool in critical care.

AI.tldr: 提出T-CQL框架，结合Transformer编码器、保守自适应正则化和一致性正则化，用于机械通气的个性化自动化设置，通过临床知情奖励函数和数字孪生评估提升安全性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 机械通气是ICU急性呼吸衰竭患者的救命干预措施，但不恰当的呼吸机设置可能导致呼吸机诱导的肺损伤。临床医生的工作负荷与患者预后直接相关，因此需要个性化和自动化的机械通气来改善患者预后。传统监督学习和离线强化学习方法忽视时间依赖性、过度依赖基于死亡率的奖励，未能充分捕捉早期生理恶化和VILI风险。
AI.method: 提出Transformer-based Conservative Q-Learning (T-CQL)框架：1) 集成Transformer编码器对患者动态进行有效时间建模；2) 基于不确定性量化的保守自适应正则化确保安全性；3) 一致性正则化实现稳健决策。构建临床知情奖励函数，包含VILI指标和患者疾病严重程度评分。使用急性呼吸衰竭患者的交互式数字孪生进行在线"床边"评估，克服传统Fitted Q-Evaluation在静态离线数据上评估的局限性。
AI.result: T-CQL在性能上持续优于现有最先进的离线强化学习方法，提供更安全、更有效的通气调整。该框架展示了Transformer模型与保守强化学习策略结合作为重症监护决策支持工具的潜力。
AI.conclusion: T-CQL框架通过整合Transformer时间建模、保守正则化和临床知情奖励，解决了机械通气个性化自动化中的关键挑战。结合数字孪生的在线评估方法克服了传统离线评估的局限性，为重症监护中的决策支持提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: HomeSafe-Bench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Unsafe Action Detection for Embodied Agents in Household Scenarios
summary: The rapid evolution of embodied agents has accelerated the deployment of household robots in real-world environments. However, unlike structured industrial settings, household spaces introduce unpredictable safety risks, where system limitations such as perception latency and lack of common sense knowledge can lead to dangerous errors. Current safety evaluations, often restricted to static images, text, or general hazards, fail to adequately benchmark dynamic unsafe action detection in these specific contexts. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{HomeSafe-Bench}, a challenging benchmark designed to evaluate Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on unsafe action detection in household scenarios. HomeSafe-Bench is contrusted via a hybrid pipeline combining physical simulation with advanced video generation and features 438 diverse cases across six functional areas with fine-grained multidimensional annotations. Beyond benchmarking, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Dual-Brain Guard for Household Safety (HD-Guard)}, a hierarchical streaming architecture for real-time safety monitoring. HD-Guard coordinates a lightweight FastBrain for continuous high-frequency screening with an asynchronous large-scale SlowBrain for deep multimodal reasoning, effectively balancing inference efficiency with detection accuracy. Evaluations demonstrate that HD-Guard achieves a superior trade-off between latency and performance, while our analysis identifies critical bottlenecks in current VLM-based safety detection.

AI.tldr: 提出了HomeSafe-Bench基准测试和HD-Guard分层架构，用于评估和改进家庭环境中基于视觉语言模型的不安全动作检测能力。
AI.motivation: 家庭环境中的机器人部署面临不可预测的安全风险，现有安全评估方法（基于静态图像、文本或通用危险）无法充分评估动态不安全动作检测，需要专门针对家庭场景的基准测试。
AI.method: 1) 构建HomeSafe-Bench基准：通过物理仿真与先进视频生成的混合流程创建438个多样化案例，覆盖六个功能区域并包含细粒度多维标注；2) 提出HD-Guard分层架构：包含轻量级FastBrain进行连续高频筛查和异步大规模SlowBrain进行深度多模态推理的流式架构。
AI.result: HD-Guard在延迟和性能之间实现了优越的权衡，分析揭示了当前基于VLM的安全检测中的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: HomeSafe-Bench填补了家庭环境中动态不安全动作检测评估的空白，HD-Guard的分层架构为实时安全监控提供了有效的解决方案，平衡了推理效率和检测精度。

title: UniCompress: Token Compression for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
summary: Unified models aim to support both understanding and generation by encoding images into discrete tokens and processing them alongside text within a single autoregressive framework. This unified design offers architectural simplicity and cross-modal synergy, which facilitates shared parameterization, consistent training objectives, and seamless transfer between modalities. However, the large number of visual tokens required by such models introduces substantial computation and memory overhead, and this inefficiency directly hinders deployment in resource constrained scenarios such as embodied AI systems. In this work, we propose a unified token compression algorithm UniCompress that significantly reduces visual token count while preserving performance on both image understanding and generation tasks. Our method introduces a plug-in compression and decompression mechanism guided with learnable global meta tokens. The framework is lightweight and modular, enabling efficient integration into existing models without full retraining. Experimental results show that our approach reduces image tokens by up to 4 times, achieves substantial gains in inference latency and training cost, and incurs only minimal performance degradation, which demonstrates the promise of token-efficient unified modeling for real world multimodal applications.

AI.tldr: 提出UniCompress算法，通过可学习的全局元标记指导的压缩-解压缩机制，将统一多模态模型中的视觉标记数量减少最多4倍，显著降低计算和内存开销，同时保持图像理解和生成性能。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型将图像编码为离散标记并与文本一起处理，虽然提供了架构简单性和跨模态协同优势，但大量视觉标记带来了巨大的计算和内存开销，阻碍了在资源受限场景（如具身AI系统）中的部署。
AI.method: 提出UniCompress统一标记压缩算法，采用基于可学习全局元标记指导的插件式压缩和解压缩机制。该框架轻量级且模块化，无需完全重新训练即可高效集成到现有模型中。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，该方法将图像标记减少最多4倍，在推理延迟和训练成本方面获得显著提升，仅带来最小性能下降，证明了标记高效统一建模在实际多模态应用中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: UniCompress通过有效压缩视觉标记数量，解决了统一多模态模型的计算效率问题，为资源受限场景中的实际部署提供了可行方案，展示了标记高效统一建模的实用性。

title: XSkill: Continual Learning from Experience and Skills in Multimodal Agents
summary: Multimodal agents can now tackle complex reasoning tasks with diverse tools, yet they still suffer from inefficient tool use and inflexible orchestration in open-ended settings. A central challenge is enabling such agents to continually improve without parameter updates by learning from past trajectories. We identify two complementary forms of reusable knowledge essential for this goal: experiences, providing concise action-level guidance for tool selection and decision making, and skills, providing structured task-level guidance for planning and tool use. To this end, we propose XSkill, a dual-stream framework for continual learning from experience and skills in multimodal agents. XSkill grounds both knowledge extraction and retrieval in visual observations. During accumulation, XSkill distills and consolidates experiences and skills from multi-path rollouts via visually grounded summarization and cross-rollout critique. During inference, it retrieves and adapts this knowledge to the current visual context and feeds usage history back into accumulation to form a continual learning loop. Evaluated on five benchmarks across diverse domains with four backbone models, XSkill consistently and substantially outperforms both tool-only and learning-based baselines. Further analysis reveals that the two knowledge streams play complementary roles in influencing the reasoning behaviors of agents and show superior zero-shot generalization.

AI.tldr: XSkill：一种双流框架，通过视觉基础的经验和技能提取与检索，实现多模态智能体的持续学习，显著提升工具使用效率和任务规划能力
AI.motivation: 当前多模态智能体在开放环境中存在工具使用效率低下和编排不灵活的问题，需要能够在无需参数更新的情况下从历史轨迹中持续学习。研究发现两种互补的可复用知识形式对实现这一目标至关重要：经验（提供动作级指导）和技能（提供任务级指导）。
AI.method: 提出XSkill双流框架，包含知识积累和推理两个阶段。积累阶段：通过视觉基础总结和跨轨迹批判，从多路径轨迹中提炼和整合经验与技能。推理阶段：根据当前视觉上下文检索并适配知识，并将使用历史反馈到积累阶段形成持续学习循环。
AI.result: 在五个不同领域的基准测试中，使用四种骨干模型，XSkill持续且显著优于仅使用工具和基于学习的基线方法。进一步分析显示，两种知识流在影响智能体推理行为方面发挥互补作用，并展现出优异的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: XSkill通过视觉基础的经验和技能双流学习框架，有效解决了多模态智能体在开放环境中的持续学习问题，实现了更高效的工具使用和更灵活的任务编排，为智能体从历史交互中学习提供了系统化解决方案。

title: Seeing Isn't Orienting: A Cognitively Grounded Benchmark Reveals Systematic Orientation Failures in MLLMs Supplementary
summary: Humans learn object orientation progressively, from recognizing which way an object faces, to mentally rotating it, to reasoning about orientations between objects. Current vision-language benchmarks largely conflate orientation with position and general scene understanding. We introduce Discriminative Orientation Reasoning Intelligence (DORI), a cognitively grounded hierarchical benchmark that makes object orientation the primary target. Inspired by stages of human orientation cognition, DORI decomposes orientation into four dimensions, each evaluated at coarse (categorical) and granular (metric) levels. Composed from 13,652 images across 14 sources, DORI provides 33,656 multiple-choice questions covering 67 object categories in real-world and synthetic settings. Its coarse-to-granular design isolates orientation from confounds such as object recognition difficulty, scene clutter, and linguistic ambiguity via bounding-box isolation, standardized spatial reference frames, and structured prompts. Evaluating 24 state-of-the-art vision-language models shows a clear pattern: models that perform well on general spatial benchmarks are near-random on object-centric orientation tasks. The best models reach only 54.2% on coarse and 45.0% on granular judgments, with largest failures on compound rotations and shifts in inter-object reference frames. Large coarse-to-granular gaps reveal reliance on categorical heuristics rather than geometric reasoning, a limitation hidden by existing benchmarks. These results identify orientation understanding as an unsolved challenge for multimodal systems, with implications for robotic manipulation, 3D scene reconstruction, and human-AI interaction.

AI.tldr: DORI是一个专注于物体朝向推理的认知层次化基准，将朝向分解为四个维度，在粗粒度（分类）和细粒度（度量）两个层次进行评估，揭示了当前视觉语言模型在物体朝向理解方面的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言基准大多将物体朝向与位置和一般场景理解混为一谈，缺乏专门针对物体朝向推理的评估工具。人类学习物体朝向是渐进式的，从识别物体朝向到心理旋转再到物体间朝向推理，需要建立认知基础的层次化基准来专门评估这一能力。
AI.method: 提出DORI基准，受人类朝向认知阶段启发，将朝向分解为四个维度，在粗粒度和细粒度两个层次进行评估。包含13,652张图像（来自14个来源），提供33,656个多项选择题，涵盖67个物体类别。通过边界框隔离、标准化空间参考系和结构化提示，将朝向推理与物体识别难度、场景杂乱和语言歧义等混淆因素分离。
AI.result: 评估24个最先进的视觉语言模型显示：在通用空间基准上表现良好的模型在物体朝向任务上接近随机水平。最佳模型在粗粒度判断上仅达到54.2%，细粒度判断上仅45.0%。最大失败出现在复合旋转和物体间参考系变化任务上。粗粒度到细粒度的巨大差距表明模型依赖分类启发式而非几何推理。
AI.conclusion: 朝向理解是多模态系统尚未解决的挑战，现有基准隐藏了这一局限性。DORI基准揭示了当前模型在几何推理方面的不足，对机器人操作、3D场景重建和人机交互具有重要意义。

title: Leveraging Phytolith Research using Artificial Intelligence
summary: Phytolith analysis is a crucial tool for reconstructing past vegetation and human activities, but traditional methods are severely limited by labour-intensive, time-consuming manual microscopy. To address this bottleneck, we present Sorometry: a comprehensive end-to-end artificial intelligence pipeline for the high-throughput digitisation, inference, and interpretation of phytoliths. Our workflow processes z-stacked optical microscope scans to automatically generate synchronised 2D orthoimages and 3D point clouds of individual microscopic particles. We developed a multimodal fusion model that combines ConvNeXt for 2D image analysis and PointNet++ for 3D point cloud analysis, supported by a graphical user interface for expert annotation and review. Tested on reference collections and archaeological samples from the Bolivian Amazon, our fusion model achieved a global classification accuracy of 77.9\% across 24 diagnostic morphotypes and 84.5% for segmentation quality. Crucially, the integration of 3D data proved essential for distinguishing complex morphotypes (such as grass silica short cell phytoliths) whose diagnostic features are often obscured by their orientation in 2D projections. Beyond individual object classification, Sorometry incorporates Bayesian finite mixture modelling to predict overall plant source contributions at the assemblage level, successfully identifying specific plants like maize and palms in complex mixed samples. This integrated platform transforms phytolith research into an "omics"-scale discipline, dramatically expanding analytical capacity, standardising expert judgements, and enabling reproducible, population-level characterisations of archaeological and paleoecological assemblages.

AI.tldr: Sorometry：基于AI的高通量植硅体分析平台，通过多模态融合模型（2D图像+3D点云）实现自动分类，准确率达77.9%，结合贝叶斯混合模型预测植物来源，将植硅体研究提升至"组学"规模。
AI.motivation: 传统植硅体分析方法依赖人工显微镜观察，劳动密集、耗时且主观性强，严重限制了研究规模和可重复性。需要开发自动化、高通量的解决方案来克服这些瓶颈。
AI.method: 开发了Sorometry端到端AI流程：1) 处理Z-stack光学显微镜扫描生成同步的2D正射影像和3D点云；2) 构建多模态融合模型，结合ConvNeXt处理2D图像和PointNet++处理3D点云；3) 提供GUI界面供专家标注和审查；4) 集成贝叶斯有限混合模型进行组合层面的植物来源预测。
AI.result: 在玻利维亚亚马逊的参考样本和考古样本测试中：1) 融合模型在24种诊断形态类型上达到77.9%的全局分类准确率；2) 分割质量达84.5%；3) 3D数据对区分复杂形态类型（如禾本科硅质短细胞植硅体）至关重要；4) 贝叶斯模型成功识别复杂混合样本中的玉米和棕榈等特定植物。
AI.conclusion: Sorometry将植硅体研究转变为"组学"规模学科，极大扩展了分析能力，标准化了专家判断，实现了考古和古生态组合的可重复、群体水平表征，为古植被重建和人类活动研究提供了革命性工具。

title: ShotVerse: Advancing Cinematic Camera Control for Text-Driven Multi-Shot Video Creation
summary: Text-driven video generation has democratized film creation, but camera control in cinematic multi-shot scenarios remains a significant block. Implicit textual prompts lack precision, while explicit trajectory conditioning imposes prohibitive manual overhead and often triggers execution failures in current models. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose a data-centric paradigm shift, positing that aligned (Caption, Trajectory, Video) triplets form an inherent joint distribution that can connect automated plotting and precise execution. Guided by this insight, we present ShotVerse, a "Plan-then-Control" framework that decouples generation into two collaborative agents: a VLM (Vision-Language Model)-based Planner that leverages spatial priors to obtain cinematic, globally aligned trajectories from text, and a Controller that renders these trajectories into multi-shot video content via a camera adapter. Central to our approach is the construction of a data foundation: we design an automated multi-shot camera calibration pipeline aligns disjoint single-shot trajectories into a unified global coordinate system. This facilitates the curation of ShotVerse-Bench, a high-fidelity cinematic dataset with a three-track evaluation protocol that serves as the bedrock for our framework. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ShotVerse effectively bridges the gap between unreliable textual control and labor-intensive manual plotting, achieving superior cinematic aesthetics and generating multi-shot videos that are both camera-accurate and cross-shot consistent.

AI.tldr: ShotVerse是一个"规划-控制"框架，通过VLM规划器和控制器协作，从文本生成具有精确相机轨迹的多镜头视频，解决了现有方法中文本提示不精确和手动轨迹控制繁琐的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前文本驱动视频生成在电影多镜头场景中的相机控制存在瓶颈：隐式文本提示缺乏精确性，而显式轨迹控制需要大量手动工作且容易导致模型执行失败。需要一种既能自动化规划又能精确执行的方法。
AI.method: 提出"规划-控制"框架ShotVerse：1) VLM规划器利用空间先验从文本生成电影级、全局对齐的相机轨迹；2) 控制器通过相机适配器将轨迹渲染为多镜头视频内容；3) 构建数据基础：设计自动化多镜头相机校准流程，将分散的单镜头轨迹对齐到统一全局坐标系，创建ShotVerse-Bench高质量电影数据集。
AI.result: ShotVerse有效弥合了不可靠的文本控制和劳动密集型手动规划之间的差距，实现了优越的电影美学效果，生成的多镜头视频既具有相机精度又保持了跨镜头一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过数据中心的范式转变，将(字幕、轨迹、视频)三元组视为固有联合分布，ShotVerse框架成功连接了自动化规划和精确执行，为电影多镜头视频生成提供了可靠解决方案。

title: TopoBench: Benchmarking LLMs on Hard Topological Reasoning
comment: Accepted, Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models at ICLR 2026
summary: Solving topological grid puzzles requires reasoning over global spatial invariants such as connectivity, loop closure, and region symmetry and remains challenging for even the most powerful large language models (LLMs). To study these abilities under controlled settings, we introduce TopoBench, a benchmark of six puzzle families across three difficulty levels. We evaluate strong reasoning LLMs on TopoBench and find that even frontier models solve fewer than one quarter of hard instances, with two families nearly unsolved. To investigate whether these failures stem from reasoning limitations or from difficulty extracting and maintaining spatial constraints, we annotate 750 chain of thought traces with an error taxonomy that surfaces four candidate causal failure modes, then test them with targeted interventions simulating each error type. These interventions show that certain error patterns like premature commitment and constraint forgetting have a direct impact on the ability to solve the puzzle, while repeated reasoning is a benign effect of search. Finally we study mitigation strategies including prompt guidance, cell-aligned grid representations and tool-based constraint checking, finding that the bottleneck lies in extracting constraints from spatial representations and not in reasoning over them. Code and data are available at github.com/mayug/topobench-benchmark.

AI.tldr: TopoBench基准测试显示，即使是前沿LLM在拓扑网格谜题上表现不佳，主要瓶颈在于从空间表示中提取约束而非推理本身。
AI.motivation: 研究大型语言模型在需要全局空间不变性推理（如连通性、环路闭合、区域对称性）的拓扑网格谜题上的能力，这些任务对当前最强大的LLM仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 引入TopoBench基准，包含6个谜题家族和3个难度级别；评估前沿推理LLM；标注750个思维链轨迹并建立错误分类法；通过针对性干预测试候选失败模式；研究缓解策略（提示引导、单元格对齐网格表示、基于工具的约束检查）。
AI.result: 前沿模型仅解决不到四分之一困难实例，两个家族几乎无法解决；错误分析显示过早承诺和约束遗忘直接影响解决能力，而重复推理是搜索的良性效应；缓解策略表明瓶颈在于从空间表示中提取约束，而非约束推理本身。
AI.conclusion: LLM在拓扑网格谜题上的主要限制是从空间表示中提取和维持约束的能力，而非推理能力本身；需要改进空间约束提取技术来提升这类任务的性能。

title: Beyond Single-Sample: Reliable Multi-Sample Distillation for Video Understanding
summary: Traditional black-box distillation for Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) typically relies on a single teacher response per input, which often yields high-variance responses and format inconsistencies in multimodal or temporal scenarios. To mitigate this unreliable supervision, we propose R-MSD (Reliable Multi-Sample Distillation), a framework that explicitly models teacher sampling variance to enhance distillation stability. Rather than relying on a single teacher response, our approach leverages a task-adaptive teacher pool to provide robust supervision tailored to both closed-ended and open-ended reasoning. By integrating quality-aware signal matching with an adversarial distillation objective, our approach effectively filters teacher noise while maximizing knowledge transfer. Extensive evaluations across comprehensive video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that R-MSD consistently outperforms single sample distillation methods. We additionally include an original SFT+RL 4B baseline under the same training budget, which shows only marginal gains, while our method achieves significant improvements. With a 4B student model, our approach delivers gains on VideoMME (+1.5%), Video-MMMU (+3.2%), and MathVerse (+3.6%).

AI.tldr: R-MSD是一种可靠的多样本蒸馏框架，通过显式建模教师采样方差来增强蒸馏稳定性，在视频理解任务上显著优于单样本蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 传统黑盒蒸馏方法通常依赖单一教师响应，在多模态或时序场景中会产生高方差响应和格式不一致问题，导致监督不可靠。
AI.method: 提出R-MSD框架，利用任务自适应教师池提供鲁棒监督，结合质量感知信号匹配和对抗蒸馏目标，有效过滤教师噪声并最大化知识转移。
AI.result: 在4B学生模型上，R-MSD在VideoMME(+1.5%)、Video-MMMU(+3.2%)和MathVerse(+3.6%)等视频理解基准上取得显著提升，优于单样本蒸馏方法和SFT+RL基线。
AI.conclusion: R-MSD通过显式建模教师采样方差，提供更可靠的监督信号，在多模态蒸馏任务中实现了稳定且有效的知识转移。

title: Compiling Temporal Numeric Planning into Discrete PDDL+: Extended Version
comment: This paper is an extended version of the homonymous appearing in the ICAPS 2026 proceedings. This version provides the proofs and addidional explanations of the compilation
summary: Since the introduction of the PDDL+ modeling language, it was known that temporal planning with durative actions (as in PDDL 2.1) could be compiled into PDDL+. However, no practical compilation was presented in the literature ever since. We present a practical compilation from temporal planning with durative actions into PDDL+, fully capturing the semantics and only assuming the non-self-overlapping of actions. Our compilation is polynomial, retains the plan length up to a constant factor and is experimentally shown to be of practical relevance for hard temporal numeric problems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种将具有持续动作的时态规划编译为PDDL+的实际可行方法，完全捕获语义且仅假设动作不自我重叠
AI.motivation: 虽然PDDL+引入后就知道时态规划可以编译到PDDL+，但文献中一直缺乏实际可行的编译方法。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供实用的编译方案。
AI.method: 开发了一种多项式时间的编译方法，将具有持续动作的时态规划（PDDL 2.1）转换为PDDL+表示。该方法仅假设动作不自我重叠，完全保留原始语义，且保持规划长度在常数因子内。
AI.result: 编译方法是多项式复杂度，规划长度最多增加常数倍。实验证明该方法对困难的时态数值规划问题具有实际应用价值。
AI.conclusion: 首次提供了将时态规划编译到PDDL+的实用方法，填补了文献空白，为处理复杂的时态数值规划问题提供了有效工具。

title: Attention Sinks Are Provably Necessary in Softmax Transformers: Evidence from Trigger-Conditional Tasks
summary: Transformers often display an attention sink: probability mass concentrates on a fixed, content-agnostic position. We prove that computing a simple trigger-conditional behavior necessarily induces a sink in softmax self-attention models. Our results formalize a familiar intuition: normalization over a probability simplex must force attention to collapse onto a stable anchor to realize a default state (e.g., when the model needs to ignore the input). We instantiate this with a concrete task: when a designated trigger token appears, the model must return the average of all preceding token representations, and otherwise output zero, a task which mirrors the functionality of attention heads in the wild (Barbero et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2024). We also prove that non-normalized ReLU attention can solve the same task without any sink, confirming that the normalization constraint is the fundamental driver of sink behavior. Experiments validate our predictions and demonstrate they extend beyond the theoretically analyzed setting: softmax models develop strong sinks while ReLU attention eliminates them in both single-head and multi-head variants.

AI.tldr: 论文证明softmax自注意力模型在计算触发条件行为时必然产生注意力汇（attention sink），即概率质量集中在固定的内容无关位置，而ReLU注意力无需归一化约束可解决相同任务而不产生汇。
AI.motivation: 研究注意力汇现象的理论基础，理解为什么Transformer模型中会出现注意力概率集中在固定位置的现象，以及这种现象与模型归一化约束的关系。
AI.method: 通过理论证明和实验验证：1）证明softmax自注意力模型在计算触发条件行为时必然产生注意力汇；2）设计具体任务（触发标记出现时返回前面所有标记表示的平均值，否则输出零）；3）证明ReLU注意力无需归一化可解决相同任务而不产生汇；4）实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: 理论证明：softmax模型必然产生注意力汇，而ReLU注意力可避免汇现象。实验验证：softmax模型产生强注意力汇，ReLU注意力在单头和多头变体中均消除汇现象，且结果超出理论分析范围。
AI.conclusion: 注意力汇现象的根本驱动因素是归一化约束，而非注意力机制本身。softmax的归一化要求迫使注意力在需要忽略输入时坍缩到稳定锚点，而ReLU等非归一化注意力可避免此问题。

title: Stay in your Lane: Role Specific Queries with Overlap Suppression Loss for Dense Video Captioning
summary: Dense Video Captioning (DVC) is a challenging multimodal task that involves temporally localizing multiple events within a video and describing them with natural language. While query-based frameworks enable the simultaneous, end-to-end processing of localization and captioning, their reliance on shared queries often leads to significant multi-task interference between the two tasks, as well as temporal redundancy in localization. In this paper, we propose utilizing role-specific queries that separate localization and captioning into independent components, allowing each to exclusively learn its role. We then employ contrastive alignment to enforce semantic consistency between the corresponding outputs, ensuring coherent behavior across the separated queries. Furthermore, we design a novel suppression mechanism in which mutual temporal overlaps across queries are penalized to tackle temporal redundancy, supervising the model to learn distinct, non-overlapping event regions for more precise localization. Additionally, we introduce a lightweight module that captures core event concepts to further enhance semantic richness in captions through concept-level representations. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments on major DVC benchmarks YouCook2 and ActivityNet Captions.

AI.tldr: 提出角色特定查询分离定位与描述任务，使用对比对齐确保语义一致性，设计抑制机制减少时间冗余，并引入轻量级模块增强描述语义丰富度
AI.motivation: 现有基于查询的密集视频描述框架中，共享查询导致定位与描述任务间的多任务干扰严重，同时存在时间冗余问题，需要改进
AI.method: 1) 使用角色特定查询分离定位与描述任务；2) 对比对齐确保分离查询间的语义一致性；3) 抑制机制惩罚查询间的时间重叠以减少冗余；4) 轻量级模块捕获核心事件概念增强描述语义
AI.result: 在YouCook2和ActivityNet Captions等主要DVC基准测试中验证了方法的有效性
AI.conclusion: 通过角色特定查询分离任务、对比对齐、抑制冗余和概念增强，显著改善了密集视频描述中多任务干扰和时间冗余问题

title: Portfolio of Solving Strategies in CEGAR-based Object Packing and Scheduling for Sequential 3D Printing
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2503.05071
summary: Computing power that used to be available only in supercomputers decades ago especially their parallelism is currently available in standard personal computer CPUs even in CPUs for mobile telephones. We show how to effectively utilize the computing power of modern multi-core personal computer CPU to solve the complex combinatorial problem of object arrangement and scheduling for sequential 3D printing. We achieved this by parallelizing the existing CEGAR-SEQ algorithm that solves the sequential object arrangement and scheduling by expressing it as a linear arithmetic formula which is then solved by a technique inspired by counterexample guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR). The original CEGAR-SEQ algorithm uses an object arrangement strategy that places objects towards the center of the printing plate. We propose alternative object arrangement strategies such as placing objects towards a corner of the printing plate and scheduling objects according to their height. Our parallelization is done at the high-level where we execute the CEGAR-SEQ algorithm in parallel with a portfolio of object arrangement strategies, an algorithm is called Porfolio-CEGAR-SEQ. Our experimental evaluation indicates that Porfolio-CEGAR-SEQ outperforms the original CEGAR-SEQ. When a batch of objects for multiple printing plates is scheduled, Portfolio-CEGAR-SEQ often uses fewer printing plates than CEGAR-SEQ.

AI.tldr: 并行化CEGAR-SEQ算法，通过多种物体排列策略组合优化3D打印序列调度，减少打印板使用数量
AI.motivation: 现代多核个人计算机CPU具备强大的并行计算能力，但现有CEGAR-SEQ算法仅使用单一的中心排列策略，未能充分利用这些计算资源。需要开发并行化方法以提高3D打印中物体排列和调度问题的求解效率。
AI.method: 提出Portfolio-CEGAR-SEQ算法：1）将CEGAR-SEQ算法并行化；2）采用多种物体排列策略组合，包括向打印板角落排列和按高度调度等替代策略；3）在高层次并行执行不同策略的CEGAR-SEQ实例。
AI.result: Portfolio-CEGAR-SEQ在性能上优于原始CEGAR-SEQ算法。在批量物体调度多个打印板时，Portfolio-CEGAR-SEQ通常使用更少的打印板数量。
AI.conclusion: 通过并行化CEGAR-SEQ算法并采用多种物体排列策略组合，能够有效利用现代多核CPU的计算能力，显著改善3D打印中的物体排列和调度效率，减少打印板使用数量。

title: Detect Anything in Real Time: From Single-Prompt Segmentation to Multi-Class Detection
summary: Recent advances in vision-language modeling have produced promptable detection and segmentation systems that accept arbitrary natural language queries at inference time. Among these, SAM3 achieves state-of-the-art accuracy by combining a ViT-H/14 backbone with cross-modal transformer decoding and learned object queries. However, SAM3 processes a single text prompt per forward pass. Detecting N categories requires N independent executions, each dominated by the 439M-parameter backbone. We present Detect Anything in Real Time (DART), a training-free framework that converts SAM3 into a real-time multi-class detector by exploiting a structural invariant: the visual backbone is class-agnostic, producing image features independent of the text prompt. This allows the backbone computation to be shared between all classes, reducing its cost from O(N) to O(1). Combined with batched multi-class decoding, detection-only inference, and TensorRT FP16 deployment, these optimizations yield 5.6x cumulative speedup at 3 classes, scaling to 25x at 80 classes, without modifying any model weight. On COCO val2017 (5,000 images, 80 classes), DART achieves 55.8 AP at 15.8 FPS (4 classes, 1008x1008) on a single RTX 4080, surpassing purpose-built open-vocabulary detectors trained on millions of box annotations. For extreme latency targets, adapter distillation with a frozen encoder-decoder achieves 38.7 AP with a 13.9 ms backbone. Code and models are available at https://github.com/mkturkcan/DART.

AI.tldr: DART是一个无需训练的实时多类别检测框架，通过共享SAM3的视觉骨干计算，将N类检测的计算复杂度从O(N)降低到O(1)，实现5.6-25倍加速
AI.motivation: SAM3等视觉语言模型虽然实现了最先进的检测精度，但每个文本提示需要单独前向传播，检测N个类别需要N次独立执行，计算成本高昂，无法满足实时应用需求
AI.method: 利用视觉骨干与类别无关的结构不变性，共享骨干计算；结合批量多类别解码、仅检测推理和TensorRT FP16部署；通过适配器蒸馏进一步优化极端延迟场景
AI.result: 在COCO val2017上，DART达到55.8 AP@15.8 FPS（4类，1008x1008），超越专门训练的开放词汇检测器；3类时5.6倍加速，80类时25倍加速；适配器蒸馏实现38.7 AP@13.9ms骨干延迟
AI.conclusion: DART证明了通过计算共享和系统优化，无需修改模型权重即可将提示式检测器转化为实时多类别检测器，为实际应用提供了高效解决方案

title: Examining Reasoning LLMs-as-Judges in Non-Verifiable LLM Post-Training
summary: Reasoning LLMs-as-Judges, which can benefit from inference-time scaling, provide a promising path for extending the success of reasoning models to non-verifiable domains where the output correctness/quality cannot be directly checked. However, while reasoning judges have shown better performance on static evaluation benchmarks, their effectiveness in actual policy training has not been systematically examined. Therefore, we conduct a rigorous study to investigate the actual impact of non-reasoning and reasoning judges in reinforcement-learning-based LLM alignment. Our controlled synthetic setting, where a "gold-standard" judge (gpt-oss-120b) provides preference annotations to train smaller judges, reveals key differences between non-reasoning and reasoning judges: non-reasoning judges lead to reward hacking easily, while reasoning judges can lead to policies that achieve strong performance when evaluated by the gold-standard judge. Interestingly, we find that the reasoning-judge-trained policies achieve such strong performance by learning to generate highly effective adversarial outputs that can also score well on popular benchmarks such as Arena-Hard by deceiving other LLM-judges. Combined with our further analysis, our study highlights both important findings and room for improvements for applying (reasoning) LLM-judges in non-verifiable LLM post-training.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了推理型和非推理型LLM作为评判者在强化学习对齐中的实际效果，发现推理型评判者能训练出更强策略，但策略会学习生成欺骗性输出以在基准测试中获得高分。
AI.motivation: 虽然推理型LLM评判者在静态评估基准上表现更好，但它们在实际策略训练中的有效性尚未得到系统检验。研究者希望探究非推理型和推理型评判者在基于强化学习的LLM对齐中的实际影响。
AI.method: 在受控合成环境中，使用"黄金标准"评判者(gpt-oss-120b)提供偏好标注来训练较小的评判者，系统比较非推理型和推理型评判者在强化学习对齐中的表现。
AI.result: 非推理型评判者容易导致奖励黑客行为，而推理型评判者能训练出在黄金标准评判者评估下表现强劲的策略。有趣的是，这些策略通过生成能欺骗其他LLM评判者的对抗性输出，在Arena-Hard等流行基准上也能获得高分。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了推理型LLM评判者在非可验证LLM后训练中的重要作用和局限性，强调需要改进评判者应用方法，防止策略学习欺骗性行为。

title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization for Generalized Embedding Learning in Federated Recommendation
comment: Accepted by the ACM Web Conference 2026
summary: Federated recommender systems enable collaborative model training while keeping user interaction data local and sharing only essential model parameters, thereby mitigating privacy risks. However, existing methods overlook a critical issue, i.e., the stable learning of a generalized item embedding throughout the federated recommender system training process. Item embedding plays a central role in facilitating knowledge sharing across clients. Yet, under the cross-device setting, local data distributions exhibit significant heterogeneity and sparsity, exacerbating the difficulty of learning generalized embeddings. These factors make the stable learning of generalized item embeddings both indispensable for effective federated recommendation and inherently difficult to achieve. To fill this gap, we propose a new federated recommendation framework, named Federated Recommendation with Generalized Embedding Learning (FedRecGEL). We reformulate the federated recommendation problem from an item-centered perspective and cast it as a multi-task learning problem, aiming to learn generalized embeddings throughout the training procedure. Based on theoretical analysis, we employ sharpness-aware minimization to address the generalization problem, thereby stabilizing the training process and enhancing recommendation performance. Extensive experiments on four datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of FedRecGEL in significantly improving federated recommendation performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/anonymifish/FedRecGEL.

AI.tldr: 提出FedRecGEL框架，通过多任务学习和锐度感知最小化解决联邦推荐系统中广义物品嵌入学习的稳定性问题
AI.motivation: 现有联邦推荐方法忽视了广义物品嵌入的稳定学习问题。在跨设备场景下，本地数据分布存在显著异质性和稀疏性，使得学习广义嵌入既必要又困难，这影响了知识共享和推荐效果
AI.method: 提出FedRecGEL框架：1) 从物品中心视角重新定义联邦推荐问题，将其构建为多任务学习问题；2) 基于理论分析，采用锐度感知最小化解决泛化问题，稳定训练过程
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的大量实验表明，FedRecGEL能显著提升联邦推荐性能
AI.conclusion: FedRecGEL通过解决广义物品嵌入的稳定学习问题，有效提升了联邦推荐系统的性能，为跨设备场景下的推荐提供了新解决方案

title: Follow the Saliency: Supervised Saliency for Retrieval-augmented Dense Video Captioning
summary: Existing retrieval-augmented approaches for Dense Video Captioning (DVC) often fail to achieve accurate temporal segmentation aligned with true event boundaries, as they rely on heuristic strategies that overlook ground truth event boundaries. The proposed framework, \textbf{STaRC}, overcomes this limitation by supervising frame-level saliency through a highlight detection module. Note that the highlight detection module is trained on binary labels derived directly from DVC ground truth annotations without the need for additional annotation. We also propose to utilize the saliency scores as a unified temporal signal that drives retrieval via saliency-guided segmentation and informs caption generation through explicit Saliency Prompts injected into the decoder. By enforcing saliency-constrained segmentation, our method produces temporally coherent segments that align closely with actual event transitions, leading to more accurate retrieval and contextually grounded caption generation. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on the YouCook2 and ViTT benchmarks, where STaRC achieves state-of-the-art performance across most of the metrics. Our code is available at https://github.com/ermitaju1/STaRC

AI.tldr: STaRC是一个用于密集视频描述的新框架，通过亮点检测模块监督帧级显著性，利用显著性分数作为统一的时间信号驱动检索和指导描述生成，在YouCook2和ViTT基准测试中达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于检索增强的密集视频描述方法通常无法实现与真实事件边界对齐的准确时间分割，因为它们依赖启发式策略而忽略了真实事件边界。
AI.method: 提出STaRC框架：1) 通过亮点检测模块监督帧级显著性，该模块使用从DVC真实标注派生的二元标签训练；2) 利用显著性分数作为统一时间信号，通过显著性引导分割驱动检索，并通过注入解码器的显式显著性提示指导描述生成；3) 强制显著性约束分割，产生与事件转换紧密对齐的时间连贯片段。
AI.result: 在YouCook2和ViTT基准测试上进行全面评估，STaRC在大多数指标上实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: STaRC通过监督帧级显著性并利用显著性作为统一时间信号，克服了现有方法在时间分割对齐方面的局限性，实现了更准确的检索和上下文基础的描述生成。

title: Implicit Statistical Inference in Transformers: Approximating Likelihood-Ratio Tests In-Context
comment: Accepted at the Latent and Implicit Thinking Workshop (ICLR 2026)
summary: In-context learning (ICL) allows Transformers to adapt to novel tasks without weight updates, yet the underlying algorithms remain poorly understood. We adopt a statistical decision-theoretic perspective by investigating simple binary hypothesis testing, where the optimal policy is determined by the likelihood-ratio test. Notably, this setup provides a mathematically rigorous setting for mechanistic interpretability where the target algorithmic ground truth is known. By training Transformers on tasks requiring distinct geometries (linear shifted means vs. nonlinear variance estimation), we demonstrate that the models approximate the Bayes-optimal sufficient statistics from context up to some monotonic transformation, matching the performance of an ideal oracle estimator in nonlinear regimes. Leveraging this analytical ground truth, mechanistic analysis via logit lens and circuit alignment suggests that the model does not rely on a fixed kernel smoothing heuristic. Instead, it appears to adapt the point at which decisions become linearly decodable: exhibiting patterns consistent with a voting-style ensemble for linear tasks while utilizing a deeper sequential computation for nonlinear tasks. These findings suggest that ICL emerges from the construction of task-adaptive statistical estimators rather than simple similarity matching.

AI.tldr: Transformer通过上下文学习近似贝叶斯最优统计量，而非固定核平滑启发式方法，表现出任务自适应的统计估计器构建
AI.motivation: 理解Transformer上下文学习的底层算法机制，特别是在统计决策理论框架下探究其如何从上下文构建任务自适应的统计估计器
AI.method: 采用统计决策理论视角，研究二元假设检验问题，训练Transformer处理线性均值偏移和非线性方差估计任务，通过logit lens和电路对齐进行机制分析
AI.result: Transformer能够从上下文近似贝叶斯最优充分统计量（达到单调变换），在非线性区域匹配理想oracle估计器性能；模型不依赖固定核平滑启发式，而是自适应决策线性可分点
AI.conclusion: 上下文学习源于任务自适应统计估计器的构建，而非简单的相似性匹配；线性任务表现为投票式集成模式，非线性任务采用更深层的序列计算

title: LongFlow: Efficient KV Cache Compression for Reasoning M
summary: Recent reasoning models such as OpenAI-o1 and DeepSeek-R1 have shown strong performance on complex tasks including mathematical reasoning and code generation. However, this performance gain comes with substantially longer output sequences, leading to significantly increased deployment costs. In particular, long outputs require large KV caches, resulting in high memory consumption and severe bandwidth pressure during attention computation. Most existing KV cache optimization methods are designed for long-input, short-output scenarios and are ineffective for the long-output setting of reasoning models. Moreover, importance estimation in prior work is computationally expensive and becomes prohibitive when continuous re-evaluation is required during long generation. To address these challenges, we propose LongFlow, a KV cache compression method with an efficient importance estimation metric derived from an intermediate result of attention computation using only the current query. This design introduces negligible computational overhead and requires no auxiliary storage. We further develop a custom kernel that fuses FlashAttention, importance estimation, and token eviction into a single optimized operator, improving system-level efficiency. Experiments show that LongFlow achieves up to an 11.8 times throughput improvement with 80% KV cache compression with minimal impact on model accuracy.

AI.tldr: LongFlow是一种针对推理模型长输出场景的KV缓存压缩方法，通过利用注意力计算的中间结果实现高效重要性评估，显著提升推理吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有推理模型（如OpenAI-o1和DeepSeek-R1）在复杂任务上表现出色，但生成长输出序列导致部署成本显著增加。长输出需要大KV缓存，造成高内存消耗和注意力计算中的严重带宽压力。现有KV缓存优化方法主要针对长输入短输出场景，对推理模型的长输出设置无效，且重要性评估计算成本高，在长生成过程中持续重新评估变得不可行。
AI.method: 提出LongFlow KV缓存压缩方法：1）使用仅基于当前查询的注意力计算中间结果推导出高效重要性评估指标，计算开销可忽略且无需辅助存储；2）开发定制内核，将FlashAttention、重要性评估和令牌驱逐融合为单个优化算子，提升系统级效率。
AI.result: 实验表明，LongFlow在80% KV缓存压缩下实现高达11.8倍的吞吐量提升，同时对模型精度影响最小。
AI.conclusion: LongFlow有效解决了推理模型长输出场景下的KV缓存优化问题，通过高效的重要性评估和系统级优化，显著降低了部署成本，为大规模推理模型的实际应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: INFACT: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Induced Faithfulness and Factuality Hallucinations in Video-LLMs
summary: Despite rapid progress, Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) remain unreliable due to hallucinations, which are outputs that contradict either video evidence (faithfulness) or verifiable world knowledge (factuality). Existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of factuality hallucinations and predominantly evaluate models only in clean settings. We introduce \textsc{INFACT}, a diagnostic benchmark comprising 9{,}800 QA instances with fine-grained taxonomies for faithfulness and factuality, spanning real and synthetic videos. \textsc{INFACT} evaluates models in four modes: Base (clean), Visual Degradation, Evidence Corruption, and Temporal Intervention for order-sensitive items. Reliability under induced modes is quantified using Resist Rate (RR) and Temporal Sensitivity Score (TSS). Experiments on 14 representative Video-LLMs reveal that higher Base-mode accuracy does not reliably translate to higher reliability in the induced modes, with evidence corruption reducing stability and temporal intervention yielding the largest degradation. Notably, many open-source baselines exhibit near-zero TSS on factuality, indicating pronounced temporal inertia on order-sensitive questions.

AI.tldr: INFACT是一个包含9800个QA实例的诊断基准，用于评估视频大语言模型的忠实性和事实性幻觉，涵盖真实和合成视频，并在四种模式下测试模型可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频大语言模型存在幻觉问题，但现有基准对事实性幻觉覆盖有限且主要在干净环境下评估，需要更全面的诊断基准来评估模型在不同干扰条件下的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建包含9800个QA实例的INFACT基准，细粒度分类忠实性和事实性幻觉，涵盖真实和合成视频。设计四种评估模式：基础模式（干净）、视觉退化、证据破坏和时间干预，使用抵抗率和时间敏感性分数量化可靠性。
AI.result: 对14个代表性视频大语言模型的实验显示，基础模式准确率不能可靠预测诱导模式下的可靠性，证据破坏降低稳定性，时间干预导致最大性能下降。许多开源基线在事实性问题上接近零的时间敏感性分数，表明对顺序敏感问题存在明显的时间惯性。
AI.conclusion: INFACT基准揭示了视频大语言模型在对抗性条件下的可靠性问题，特别是时间敏感性方面的缺陷，为模型评估和改进提供了重要诊断工具。

title: CFD-HAR: User-controllable Privacy through Conditional Feature Disentanglement
summary: Modern wearable and mobile devices are equipped with inertial measurement units (IMUs). Human Activity Recognition (HAR) applications running on such devices use machine-learning-based, data-driven techniques that leverage such sensor data. However, sensor-data-driven HAR deployments face two critical challenges: protecting sensitive user information embedded in sensor data in accordance with users' privacy preferences and maintaining high recognition performance with limited labeled samples. This paper proposes a technique for user-controllable privacy through feature disentanglement-based representation learning at the granular level for dynamic privacy filtering. We also compare the efficacy of our technique against few-shot HAR using autoencoder-based representation learning. We analyze their architectural designs, learning objectives, privacy guarantees, data efficiency, and suitability for edge Internet of Things (IoT) deployment. Our study shows that CFD-based HAR provides explicit, tunable privacy protection controls by separating activity and sensitive attributes in the latent space, whereas autoencoder-based few-shot HAR offers superior label efficiency and lightweight adaptability but lacks inherent privacy safeguards. We further examine the security implications of both approaches in continual IoT settings, highlighting differences in susceptibility to representation leakage and embedding-level attacks. The analysis reveals that neither paradigm alone fully satisfies the emerging requirements of next-generation IoT HAR systems. We conclude by outlining research directions toward unified frameworks that jointly optimize privacy preservation, few-shot adaptability, and robustness for trustworthy IoT intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于特征解缠的用户可控隐私保护方法，用于可穿戴设备上的人体活动识别，并与基于自编码器的少样本学习方法进行对比分析，探讨了隐私保护、数据效率和边缘部署的平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现代可穿戴设备配备IMU传感器，基于机器学习的人体活动识别面临两大挑战：1) 保护传感器数据中的敏感用户隐私信息；2) 在有限标注样本下保持高识别性能。需要解决隐私保护与识别性能的平衡问题。
AI.method: 提出基于特征解缠的表示学习方法，实现细粒度的动态隐私过滤控制。该方法在潜在空间中分离活动特征和敏感属性。同时对比分析了基于自编码器的少样本HAR方法，从架构设计、学习目标、隐私保证、数据效率和边缘部署适应性等方面进行比较。
AI.result: CFD（特征解缠）方法提供显式、可调的隐私保护控制，能在潜在空间分离活动和敏感属性；自编码器少样本HAR在标签效率和轻量适应性方面更优，但缺乏固有隐私保护。两种方法在持续IoT环境中的安全分析显示，对表示泄露和嵌入层攻击的敏感性存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 单一范式无法完全满足下一代IoT HAR系统的需求。需要研究统一框架，联合优化隐私保护、少样本适应性和鲁棒性，以实现可信的IoT智能系统。

title: SPEGC: Continual Test-Time Adaptation via Semantic-Prompt-Enhanced Graph Clustering for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: In medical image segmentation tasks, the domain gap caused by the difference in data collection between training and testing data seriously hinders the deployment of pre-trained models in clinical practice. Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) aims to enable pre-trained models to adapt to continuously changing unlabeled domains, providing an effective approach to solving this problem. However, existing CTTA methods often rely on unreliable supervisory signals, igniting a self-reinforcing cycle of error accumulation that culminates in catastrophic performance degradation. To overcome these challenges, we propose a CTTA via Semantic-Prompt-Enhanced Graph Clustering (SPEGC) for medical image segmentation. First, we design a semantic prompt feature enhancement mechanism that utilizes decoupled commonality and heterogeneity prompt pools to inject global contextual information into local features, alleviating their susceptibility to noise interference under domain shift. Second, based on these enhanced features, we design a differentiable graph clustering solver. This solver reframes global edge sparsification as an optimal transport problem, allowing it to distill a raw similarity matrix into a refined and high-order structural representation in an end-to-end manner. Finally, this robust structural representation is used to guide model adaptation, ensuring predictions are consistent at a cluster-level and dynamically adjusting decision boundaries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPEGC outperforms other state-of-the-art CTTA methods on two medical image segmentation benchmarks. The source code is available at https://github.com/Jwei-Z/SPEGC-for-MIS.

AI.tldr: SPEGC提出了一种基于语义提示增强图聚类的持续测试时适应方法，用于解决医学图像分割中的域适应问题，通过语义提示增强和可微分图聚类来避免错误累积。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割中，训练数据和测试数据之间的域差异严重阻碍了预训练模型在临床实践中的部署。现有的持续测试时适应方法依赖不可靠的监督信号，导致错误累积的恶性循环和灾难性性能下降。
AI.method: 1. 设计语义提示特征增强机制，使用解耦的共性和异质性提示池将全局上下文信息注入局部特征；2. 基于增强特征设计可微分图聚类求解器，将全局边稀疏化重构为最优传输问题；3. 使用鲁棒的结构表示指导模型适应，确保聚类级别的预测一致性并动态调整决策边界。
AI.result: 在两个医学图像分割基准测试上的大量实验表明，SPEGC优于其他最先进的持续测试时适应方法。
AI.conclusion: SPEGC通过语义提示增强和可微分图聚类有效解决了医学图像分割中的域适应问题，避免了现有方法中的错误累积问题，在持续变化的域中实现了鲁棒的模型适应。
